````python
# Pre-compile tech patterns once for performance.
_TECH_PATTERNS: list[tuple[re.Pattern[str], str]] = [
    (re.compile(rf"\b{re.escape(tech)}\b", re.IGNORECASE), tech)
    for tech in _KNOWN_TECHNOLOGIES
]

# ── Employment-type keywords ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

_EMPLOYMENT_TYPE_PATTERNS: list[tuple[str, str]] = [
    (r"full[- ]time", "Full-time"),
    (r"part[- ]time", "Part-time"),
    (r"\bcontract\b", "Contract"),
    (r"\bfreelance\b", "Freelance"),
    (r"\binternship\b", "Internship"),
    (r"\btemporary\b", "Temporary"),
]

# Words to strip from bullet lines before adding to a list field.
_BULLET_PREFIX = re.compile(r"^[\s•\-–—*·▪▸►✓✔→]+")

# Experience pattern: "3+ years", "5 years", "senior level", etc.
_EXPERIENCE_PATTERN = re.compile(
    r"(\d+\+?\s+years?|senior|mid[- ]?level|junior|entry[- ]?level|lead)",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)


# ── Public API ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────


def parse_job_description(text: str) -> JobDescription:
    """Convert raw job description text into a structured ``JobDescription``.

    The function never raises; missing information is represented as empty
    strings or empty lists so callers always receive a complete model.
    """
    lines = _split_lines(text)
    buckets = _split_into_buckets(lines)
    preamble = buckets.get("preamble", [])

    return JobDescription(
        title=_extract_title(preamble, lines),
        company=_extract_company(preamble, text),
        location=_extract_location(preamble, text),
        employment_type=_extract_employment_type(text),
        experience_required=_extract_experience(text),
        responsibilities=_clean_list(buckets.get("responsibilities", [])),
        required_skills=_clean_list(buckets.get("required_skills", [])),
        preferred_skills=_clean_list(buckets.get("preferred_skills", [])),
        technologies=_extract_technologies(text),
        keywords=_extract_keywords(text, buckets),
        raw_text=text,
    )


# ── Section splitter ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────


def _split_lines(text: str) -> list[str]:
    """Normalise line endings and return non-blank lines."""
    return [line.strip() for line in text.splitlines()]


def _split_into_buckets(lines: list[str]) -> dict[str, list[str]]:
    """Assign each line to a named bucket based on section headers.

    Lines before the first recognised header go into "preamble".
    Lines under an ``_ignore`` header are discarded.
    """
    buckets: dict[str, list[str]] = {"preamble": []}
    current = "preamble"

    for line in lines:
        if not line:
            continue
        matched = _match_section_header(line)
        if matched:
            current = matched
            if current not in buckets:
                buckets[current] = []
        elif current != "_ignore":
            buckets.setdefault(current, []).append(line)

    return buckets


def _match_section_header(line: str) -> str | None:
    """Return the bucket name if the line is a known section header, else None.

    A line qualifies as a header only when it is short (≤ 60 chars) and
    all its words are either title-cased, uppercase, or common particles.
    This avoids treating a body sentence that happens to contain the word
    "requirements" as a header.
    """
    if len(line) > 60:
        return None
    stripped = line.strip(":").strip()
    for pattern, bucket in _SECTION_PATTERNS:
        if re.search(pattern, stripped, re.IGNORECASE):
            return bucket
    return None


# ── List field helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────


def _clean_list(lines: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    """Strip bullet characters, deduplicate, and drop very short items."""
    seen: set[str] = set()
    result: list[str] = []
    for line in lines:
        clean = _BULLET_PREFIX.sub("", line).strip()
        # Skip header echoes (the heading line itself gets captured)
        if len(clean) < 3:
            continue
        key = clean.lower()
        if key not in seen:
            seen.add(key)
            result.append(clean)
    return result


# ── Metadata extractors ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────


def _extract_title(preamble: list[str], lines: list[str] | None = None) -> str:
    """Return the most likely job title from the preamble or full lines.

    Skips generic header phrases and scraper noise (e.g. 'Company logo for...', 'Over 100 people applied').
    """
    generic_headers = {
        "full job description", "job description", "about the role", "overview",
        "job summary", "description", "about us", "position overview", "role summary",
        "job title", "details", "role details", "careers", "position description", "about the position",
        "about the job", "role details", "job search faster"
    }

    noise_regex = re.compile(
        r"(company logo for|logo for|^logo\b|\breposted\b|over \d+ people|promoted by|responses managed|"
        r"cancel anytime|reactivate premium|messagingyou are on|navigating to|followers|members who share|"
        r"show match details|people you can reach out to|meet the hiring team|job search faster|about the company|"
        r"software development|employees)",
        re.IGNORECASE
    )

    all_lines = preamble + (lines or [])

    # 1. Look for explicit label "Job Title: <Role>" or "Role: <Role>"
    for line in all_lines:
        t = line.strip()
        lower = t.lower().rstrip(":").strip()
        if not t or noise_regex.search(lower):
            continue
        if lower.startswith("title:") or lower.startswith("job title:") or lower.startswith("role:"):
            colon_idx = t.find(":")
            val = t[colon_idx + 1:].strip()
            if val and val.lower() not in generic_headers and not noise_regex.search(val):
                return val

    # 2. Prioritize finding a short line (<= 80 chars) that contains a recognised role keyword
    role_titles = [
        "developer", "engineer", "architect", "manager", "lead", "designer",
        "consultant", "analyst", "specialist", "administrator", "executive",
        "fullstack", "backend", "frontend", "devops", "sre", "scientist",
        "director", "head", "vp", "associate", "intern", "product"
    ]

    for line in all_lines[:15]:
        t = line.strip()
        lower = t.lower().rstrip(":").strip()
        if not t or lower in generic_headers or lower.startswith("http") or noise_regex.search(lower):
            continue
        if len(t) <= 80 and any(r in lower for r in role_titles):
            return t

    # 3. Fallback: check preamble lines, skipping generic headers and noise
    for line in preamble:
        t = line.strip()
        lower = t.lower().rstrip(":").strip()
        if not t or lower in generic_headers or lower.startswith("http") or noise_regex.search(lower):
            continue
        if len(t) <= 60:
            return t

    return "Target Role"


def _extract_company(preamble: list[str], text: str) -> str:
    """Return the company name if it can be identified.

    Looks for explicit "Company: <Name>" label, "Company logo for, <Name>",
    or "<Title> at <Company>" in preamble.
    """
    # Check "Company logo for, <Name>" pattern common in LinkedIn pastes
    logo_match = re.search(r"company logo for,?\s*([A-Za-z0-9 &.'-]+)", text, re.IGNORECASE)
    if logo_match:
        cand = logo_match.group(1).strip().rstrip(".,")
        if cand and len(cand) <= 40:
            return cand

    company_explicit = re.search(
        r"company\s*[:–-]\s*(.+)", text, re.IGNORECASE
    )
    if company_explicit:
        return company_explicit.group(1).strip()

    # Only look for the "<Title> at <Company>" pattern in the preamble
    # (first 3 non-empty lines) to avoid body-text false positives.
    preamble_text = " ".join(preamble[:5])
    at_pattern = re.search(r"\bat\s+([A-Z][A-Za-z0-9 &.'-]{2,30})(?=[\s,.]|$)", preamble_text)
    if at_pattern:
        candidate = at_pattern.group(1).strip()
        # Reject if it starts with a lowercase continuation word
        if candidate and candidate[0].isupper() and len(candidate.split()) <= 5:
            return candidate

    return ""


def _extract_location(preamble: list[str], text: str) -> str:
    """Return location or remote status from the text."""
    # Explicit label
    location_label = re.search(
        r"location\s*[:–-]\s*(.+)", text, re.IGNORECASE
    )
    if location_label:
        return location_label.group(1).strip()

    # Remote variants
    if re.search(r"\bfully[- ]remote\b", text, re.IGNORECASE):
        return "Remote"
    if re.search(r"\bremote\b", text, re.IGNORECASE):
        return "Remote"
    if re.search(r"\bhybrid\b", text, re.IGNORECASE):
        return "Hybrid"

    # "City, State" or "City, Country" pattern in preamble
    for line in preamble:
        if re.search(r"[A-Z][a-z]+,\s+[A-Z]", line):
            return line

    return ""


def _extract_employment_type(text: str) -> str:
    """Return the employment type if stated."""
    for pattern, label in _EMPLOYMENT_TYPE_PATTERNS:
        if re.search(pattern, text, re.IGNORECASE):
            return label
    return ""


def _extract_experience(text: str) -> str:
    """Return the first experience requirement found in the text.

    Searches for the pattern only within lines that contain digits or
    explicit level words, to avoid matching the job title line which may
    start with "Senior" but is not an experience statement.
    """
    for line in text.splitlines():
        stripped = line.strip()
        # Skip very short lines and lines without a digit or level indicator
        if len(stripped) < 10:
            continue
        match = _EXPERIENCE_PATTERN.search(stripped)
        if match:
            # Prefer lines that also contain "year" or "experience" as
            # stronger signals that this is an experience requirement.
            if re.search(r"year|experience|level", stripped, re.IGNORECASE):
                return _BULLET_PREFIX.sub("", stripped[:120]).strip()
    # Fallback: return the first match anywhere in the text
    match = _EXPERIENCE_PATTERN.search(text)
    if match:
        start = max(0, match.start() - 10)
        end = min(len(text), match.end() + 40)
        lines = text[start:end].strip().splitlines()
        return lines[0].strip() if lines else ""
    return ""


# ── Technology extraction ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────


def _extract_technologies(text: str) -> list[str]:
    """Return every known technology mentioned in the text, deduplicated."""
    found: dict[str, str] = {}  # lower → canonical form
    for pattern, canonical in _TECH_PATTERNS:
        if pattern.search(text):
            found[canonical.lower()] = canonical
    return sorted(found.values())


# ── Keyword extraction ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Domain-specific soft skills and multi-word phrases matched across ALL industries.
# These supplement frequency-based keyword extraction for non-tech resumes.
_KNOWN_SOFT_SKILLS: list[str] = [
    # Universal professional skills
    "Communication", "Leadership", "Teamwork", "Problem Solving",
    "Critical Thinking", "Time Management", "Attention to Detail",
    "Analytical Skills", "Decision Making", "Conflict Resolution",
    "Stakeholder Management", "Project Management", "Change Management",
    "Strategic Planning", "Cross-functional", "Interpersonal Skills",
    "Negotiation", "Presentation Skills", "Written Communication",
    "Verbal Communication", "Adaptability", "Multitasking",
    # Sales & Business
    "Customer Relationship", "Client Management", "Business Development",
    "Pipeline Management", "Cold Calling", "Account Management",
    "Revenue Growth", "Sales Strategy", "Market Analysis",
    "Competitive Analysis", "B2B", "B2C",
    # Finance & Accounting
    "Financial Analysis", "Budget Management", "Cost Reduction",
    "Profit & Loss", "Revenue Forecasting", "Cash Flow Management",
    "Tax Compliance", "Financial Reporting", "Credit Analysis",
    # Logistics & Operations
    "Customs Clearance", "Freight Management", "Inventory Control",
    "Demand Planning", "Vendor Management", "Supplier Relations",
    "Warehouse Management", "Fleet Management", "Route Optimization",
    # HR
    "Talent Acquisition", "Employee Relations", "Workforce Planning",
    "Performance Appraisal", "Training & Development", "Culture Building",
    # Healthcare
    "Patient Care", "Clinical Documentation", "Medical Records",
    "Healthcare Compliance", "Patient Safety", "Electronic Health Records",
    # Marketing
    "Brand Management", "Content Strategy", "Digital Marketing",
    "Campaign Management", "Lead Generation", "Customer Acquisition",
    "Market Research", "Social Media Management",
    # Education
    "Curriculum Development", "Classroom Management", "Student Engagement",
]

# Pre-compile soft skill patterns once.
_SOFT_SKILL_PATTERNS: list[tuple[re.Pattern[str], str]] = [
    (re.compile(rf"\b{re.escape(skill)}\b", re.IGNORECASE), skill)
    for skill in _KNOWN_SOFT_SKILLS
]

# Common English stop-words and generic job-posting noise to exclude from keywords.
_STOP_WORDS: frozenset[str] = frozenset({
    "the", "and", "for", "with", "that", "this", "from", "will", "have",
    "your", "our", "you", "are", "not", "but", "can", "all", "also",
    "any", "who", "how", "what", "when", "where", "than", "been", "more",
    "they", "their", "them", "into", "its", "over", "such", "each",
    "well", "both", "about", "work", "team", "role", "skills", "using",
    "able", "must", "should", "would", "could", "other", "some", "within",
    "across", "which", "through", "strong", "experience", "understanding",
    "knowledge", "ability", "great", "excellent", "help", "build",
    "develop", "design", "implement", "support", "manage", "ensure",
    "provide", "create", "including", "related", "required", "preferred",
    "access", "agency", "applications", "building", "business", "developer",
    "internal", "message", "operations", "premium", "recruitment", "tools",
    "user", "users", "client", "clients", "service", "services", "system",
    "systems", "solution", "solutions", "years", "level", "position",
    "company", "candidate", "candidates", "ideal", "successful", "looking",
    "join", "daily", "overall", "practices", "responsibilities", "requirements",
    "opportunity", "opportunities", "environment", "environments", "focus",
    "focused", "high", "plus", "needs", "need", "deliver", "delivering",
    "collaborate", "collaborating", "driven", "drive", "drives",
})


def _extract_keywords(text: str, buckets: dict[str, list[str]] | None = None) -> list[str]:
    """Extract domain keywords, skills, and competencies across ANY industry.

    Extracts high-value requirement tokens from the job description's qualifications, skills,
    and responsibilities, rather than counting random repeated English nouns.
    """
    found_skills: list[str] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()

    # Pass 1: Extract domain skills from required_skills, preferred_skills, and responsibilities
    candidate_lines: list[str] = []
    if buckets:
        candidate_lines.extend(buckets.get("required_skills", []))
        candidate_lines.extend(buckets.get("preferred_skills", []))
        # Also take first few key responsibility lines if skills section is sparse
        if len(candidate_lines) < 3:
            candidate_lines.extend(buckets.get("responsibilities", [])[:5])

    for line in candidate_lines:
        clean = _BULLET_PREFIX.sub("", line).strip()
        # Clean leading introductory phrases like "Experience with", "Knowledge of", "Ability to"
        clean = re.sub(r"^(experience (with|in)|proficien(t|cy) (in|with)|knowledge of|familiarity with|strong understanding of|ability to|proven track record in|expertise in)\s+", "", clean, flags=re.IGNORECASE).strip()
        
        # Split on commas, semicolons, or " and "
        parts = re.split(r"[,;]|\s+(?:and|&)\s+", clean)
        for p in parts:
            p_clean = p.strip().rstrip(".")
            # Filter out full sentences or noise words
            if 2 <= len(p_clean) <= 40 and len(p_clean.split()) <= 4:
                lower = p_clean.lower()
                if lower not in _STOP_WORDS and not any(w in lower for w in ["willing", "urgency", "fast", "time", "lead", "process", "platform"]):
                    if lower not in seen:
                        seen.add(lower)
                        # Clean title case
                        words = p_clean.split()
                        formatted = " ".join(w if w.isupper() and len(w) <= 4 else w.capitalize() for w in words)
                        found_skills.append(formatted)

    # Pass 2: Match domain/soft skills across all industries (Logistics, Customs, Finance, Healthcare, Sales, etc.)
    for pattern, canonical in _SOFT_SKILL_PATTERNS:
        if pattern.search(text) and canonical.lower() not in seen:
            found_skills.append(canonical)
            seen.add(canonical.lower())

    return found_skills[:35]
````

## File: backend/app/services/resume_analysis_workflow.py
````python
"""Resume analysis workflow.

Orchestrates the entire analysis pipeline: loading document sections,
parsing the target job description, performing deterministic comparators,
and running a unified recruiter-centric review on the full document.
"""

from loguru import logger

from app.constants.resume_keywords import (
    UNIVERSAL_ROLE_TITLES,
    PRESERVE_VERBATIM_SECTIONS,
    EXPERIENCE_SECTION_KEYWORDS,
)
from app.schemas.analysis import Priority
from app.schemas.comparison import ComparisonResult, SectionComparison
from app.schemas.resume_analysis import (
    OverallSummary,
    ResumeAnalysisResult,
    ReviewedSection,
    StrengthItem,
    ImprovementItem,
)
from app.schemas.review import ReviewStatus, SectionReviewItem
from app.schemas.section import SectionItem
from app.schemas.structured_resume import StructuredResume
from app.services.comparison_service import ComparisonService
from app.services.job_description_service import JobDescriptionService
from app.services.review_service import ReviewService
from app.services.section_service import SectionService
from app.services.structured_resume_text_service import serialize_to_sections


from app.services.analysis_cache import global_analysis_cache


class ResumeAnalysisWorkflow:
    """Orchestrates the full recruiter-centric resume analysis pipeline."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        section_service: SectionService,
        jd_service: JobDescriptionService,
        comparison_service: ComparisonService,
        review_service: ReviewService,
    ) -> None:
        self._sections = section_service
        self._jd = jd_service
        self._comparison = comparison_service
        self._review = review_service

    def run(
        self,
        document_id: str,
        job_description_text: str,
    ) -> ResumeAnalysisResult:
        """Execute all pipeline steps and return the merged result."""
        logger.info("Resume analysis workflow started", document_id=document_id)

        # Step 1 – Load sections
        sections_response = self._sections.detect_document_sections(document_id)
        sections = sections_response.sections
        logger.debug("Sections loaded", count=len(sections))

        return self._run_pipeline(sections=sections, document_id=document_id, job_description_text=job_description_text)

    def run_from_structured(
        self,
        resume: StructuredResume,
        job_description_text: str,
        document_id: str = "structured",
    ) -> ResumeAnalysisResult:
        """Run the full analysis pipeline directly from a StructuredResume JSON object.

        This method bypasses DOCX file loading entirely — no file on disk is needed.
        The ``StructuredResume`` is serialized to a ``list[SectionItem]`` by
        ``serialize_to_sections()`` and fed directly into the compare + review pipeline.

        This is the JSON-first path used when the user has a master resume in DB.
        """
        logger.info("Resume analysis workflow started from structured JSON", document_id=document_id)
        sections = serialize_to_sections(resume)
        logger.debug("Sections serialized from JSON", count=len(sections))
        return self._run_pipeline(sections=sections, document_id=document_id, job_description_text=job_description_text)

    def _run_pipeline(
        self,
        sections: list[SectionItem],
        document_id: str,
        job_description_text: str,
    ) -> ResumeAnalysisResult:
        # Build cache key from full resume content + JD
        full_resume_text = "\n".join(
            " ".join(p.text for p in s.paragraphs) for s in sections
        )
        cache_key = global_analysis_cache.compute_key(full_resume_text, job_description_text)
        cached_result = global_analysis_cache.get(cache_key)
        if cached_result:
            logger.info("⚡ Returning instant cached analysis result in ~5ms")
            # Maintain document_id for caller
            return ResumeAnalysisResult(
                document_id=document_id,
                overall_summary=cached_result.overall_summary,
                sections=cached_result.sections,
                top_strengths=cached_result.top_strengths,
                top_improvements=cached_result.top_improvements,
            )

        # Step 2 – Parse job description
        job_description = self._jd.parse(job_description_text)
        logger.debug("Job description parsed", title=job_description.title)

        # Step 3 – Compare
        comparison = self._comparison.compare(sections, job_description)
        logger.debug(
            "Comparison complete",
            coverage=comparison.overall_coverage_percentage,
        )

        # Step 4 – Unified Recruiter Review
        logger.info("Running unified recruiter-centric resume review")
        
        # Filter sections to only analyze major content sections, excluding
        # Education, header, contact details, and preserve-verbatim sections.
        sections_to_analyze = []
        for s in sections:
            norm = (s.normalized_name or "").lower()
            title_lower = s.title.lower().strip()

            # Always skip header and education
            if norm in ["header", "education"]:
                continue

            # Skip preserve-verbatim sections (languages, interests, additional info etc.)
            if norm in PRESERVE_VERBATIM_SECTIONS:
                continue

            # Skip title-level education variants
            if (
                "education" in title_lower
                or "academic" in title_lower
                or "qualification" in title_lower
            ):
                continue

            # Skip inline contact/technology labels
            if (
                title_lower.startswith("technologies:")
                or title_lower.startswith("tech:")
                or title_lower.startswith("tech stack:")
                or title_lower.startswith("+")
                or "email:" in title_lower
                or "phone:" in title_lower
                or "linkedin.com" in title_lower
                or "github.com" in title_lower
            ):
                continue

            # Skip container headings that have no body content of their own (only the title line)
            # because their actual content lives in the sub-sections (job entries / project entries) that follow them!
            body_text_paras = [
                p.text.strip() for p in s.paragraphs
                if p.text.strip().lower() != s.title.strip().lower()
            ]
            if not body_text_paras and norm in ["experience", "projects", "certifications", "awards"]:
                logger.info(f"Skipping container heading section from AI review: '{s.title}'")
                continue

            sections_to_analyze.append(s)

        unified_result = self._review.review_resume(
            sections=sections_to_analyze,
            comparison=comparison,
            job_description=job_description,
        )

        # Step 5 – Merge comparisons and AI reviews
        reviewed_sections: list[ReviewedSection] = []
        comparison_by_name = _index_comparisons(comparison)

        def _normalize_title(t: str) -> str:
            clean_t = t.replace("[", "").replace("]", "").strip()
            return " ".join(clean_t.lower().split())

        # Find experience review from LLM if any
        exp_review = next(
            (r for r in unified_result.sections if _normalize_title(r.section_name) in [
                "professional experiences", "professional experience", "work experience", "experience", "employment history", "employment", "experiences"
            ]),
            None
        )

        date_kws = ["present", "201", "202", "jan", "feb", "mar", "apr", "may", "jun", "jul", "aug", "sep", "oct", "nov", "dec"]

        # Build universal role title set for sub-section detection (lower-cased)
        _role_kw_set = set(UNIVERSAL_ROLE_TITLES)

        def _is_experience_sub_section(sec) -> bool:
            """Return True if this section looks like a job-entry sub-heading."""
            import re as _re
            t = sec.title.lower()
            return (
                any(kw in t for kw in EXPERIENCE_SECTION_KEYWORDS)
                or any(rk in t for rk in _role_kw_set)
                or _re.search(r"\b(19|20)\d{2}\b", t) is not None
                or "present" in t
                or any(dk in t for dk in date_kws)
            )

        processed_section_ids = set()

        def _get_section_evidence(sec: DetectedSection) -> list[str]:
            lines = [p.text.strip() for p in sec.paragraphs if p.text and p.text.strip()]
            if lines:
                return lines
            norm_t = " ".join(sec.title.lower().split())
            for target in sections:
                if " ".join(target.title.lower().split()) == norm_t:
                    fallback = [p.text.strip() for p in target.paragraphs if p.text and p.text.strip()]
                    if fallback:
                        return fallback
            return [sec.title]

        def _get_missing_keywords(sec_item: SectionItem, sec_comp: SectionComparison) -> list[str]:
            missing = list(sec_comp.missing_keywords) + list(sec_comp.missing_technologies)
            title_l = sec_item.title.lower()
            if not missing or any(k in title_l for k in ["skill", "competenc", "tech", "summary", "qualification"]):
                missing.extend(comparison.missing_skills)
                missing.extend(comparison.missing_technologies)
                missing.extend(comparison.keyword_gaps)
            seen = set()
            result = []
            for item in missing:
                item_clean = item.strip()
                if item_clean and item_clean.lower() not in seen:
                    seen.add(item_clean.lower())
                    result.append(item_clean)
            return result

        for s_review in unified_result.sections:
            if s_review == exp_review:
                continue

            section_item = next(
                (s for s in sections_to_analyze if _normalize_title(s.title) == _normalize_title(s_review.section_name)),
                None
            )
            if not section_item:
                logger.warning(
                    f"Discarding AI section review: section title '{s_review.section_name}' does not match any detected section titles in the resume."
                )
                continue

            processed_section_ids.add(section_item.title)
            section_comparison = _find_comparison(section_item, comparison_by_name)

            def _sanitize_status(title: str, status: ReviewStatus) -> ReviewStatus:
                norm = title.lower()
                is_core = any(kw in norm for kw in ["experience", "work", "employment", "career", "role", "developer", "engineer", "executive", "project", "skill", "summary", "profile"])
                if is_core and status == ReviewStatus.REDUCE_EMPHASIS:
                    return ReviewStatus.IMPROVE
                return status

            reviewed_sections.append(
                ReviewedSection(
                    section_name=section_item.title,
                    review_status=_sanitize_status(section_item.title, s_review.review_status),
                    rewrite_worthwhile=s_review.rewrite_worthwhile,
                    priority=s_review.priority,
                    reason=s_review.reason,
                    recommendations=s_review.recommendations,
                    evidence_used=_get_section_evidence(section_item),
                    missing_keywords=_get_missing_keywords(section_item, section_comparison),
                    strengths=s_review.strengths,
                    coverage_percentage=section_comparison.coverage_percentage,
                    recruiter_impact="",
                    ats_impact="",
                )
            )

        # Map experience review to ALL experience role entries (universal role detection)
        for s in sections_to_analyze:
            if _is_experience_sub_section(s):
                if s.title not in processed_section_ids:
                    processed_section_ids.add(s.title)
                    section_comparison = _find_comparison(s, comparison_by_name)
                    
                    if exp_review:
                        reviewed_sections.append(
                            ReviewedSection(
                                section_name=s.title,
                                review_status=_sanitize_status(s.title, exp_review.review_status),
                                rewrite_worthwhile=exp_review.rewrite_worthwhile,
                                priority=exp_review.priority,
                                reason=exp_review.reason,
                                recommendations=exp_review.recommendations,
                                evidence_used=_get_section_evidence(s),
                                missing_keywords=_get_missing_keywords(s, section_comparison),
                                strengths=exp_review.strengths,
                                coverage_percentage=section_comparison.coverage_percentage,
                                recruiter_impact="",
                                ats_impact="",
                            )
                        )
                    else:
                        reviewed_sections.append(
                            ReviewedSection(
                                section_name=s.title,
                                review_status=ReviewStatus.IMPROVE,
                                rewrite_worthwhile=True,
                                priority=Priority.HIGH,
                                reason="Tailor role achievements and technical metrics using Google XYZ formula.",
                                recommendations=["Re-structure bullet points using Google XYZ metric formula while preserving original technical evidence."],
                                evidence_used=_get_section_evidence(s),
                                missing_keywords=_get_missing_keywords(s, section_comparison),
                                strengths=["Chronological employment history preserved."],
                                coverage_percentage=section_comparison.coverage_percentage,
                                recruiter_impact="",
                                ats_impact="",
                            )
                        )

        # Now fill in default reviews for any other un-analyzed sections to ensure they are editable
        for s in sections_to_analyze:
            if s.title not in processed_section_ids:
                processed_section_ids.add(s.title)
                section_comparison = _find_comparison(s, comparison_by_name)
                reviewed_sections.append(
                    ReviewedSection(
                        section_name=s.title,
                        review_status=ReviewStatus.KEEP,
                        rewrite_worthwhile=False,
                        priority=Priority.LOW,
                        reason="Section is high quality and aligns well with the profile.",
                        recommendations=[],
                        evidence_used=_get_section_evidence(s),
                        missing_keywords=_get_missing_keywords(s, section_comparison),
                        strengths=["Clear representation of candidate profile."],
                        coverage_percentage=section_comparison.coverage_percentage,
                        recruiter_impact="",
                        ats_impact="",
                    )
                )

        # Partition reviewed_sections by status and enforce limits (max 5 each)
        improve_secs = [s for s in reviewed_sections if s.review_status == ReviewStatus.IMPROVE]
        keep_secs = [s for s in reviewed_sections if s.review_status == ReviewStatus.KEEP]
        reduce_secs = [s for s in reviewed_sections if s.review_status == ReviewStatus.REDUCE_EMPHASIS]

        # Prioritize improve sections by priority (high -> medium -> low)
        priority_weights = {"high": 3, "medium": 2, "low": 1}
        improve_secs.sort(key=lambda s: priority_weights.get(s.priority.value, 0), reverse=True)

        limited_sections = (
            improve_secs[:5] +
            keep_secs[:5] +
            reduce_secs[:5]
        )

        resolved_job_title = (
            unified_result.target_job_title
            if (unified_result.target_job_title and unified_result.target_job_title.lower().strip() not in ["target role", "full job description", "job description", "overview"])
            else (job_description.title if (job_description.title and job_description.title.lower().strip() not in ["full job description", "job description", "target role", "overview"]) else "Target Role")
        )

        # Step 6 – Merge and return
        result = _build_result(
            document_id=document_id,
            job_title=resolved_job_title,
            comparison=comparison,
            reviewed_sections=limited_sections,
            top_strengths=unified_result.top_strengths,
            top_improvements=unified_result.top_improvements,
        )

        logger.info(
            "Resume analysis workflow complete",
            document_id=document_id,
            sections_reviewed=result.overall_summary.sections_reviewed,
            sections_to_improve=result.overall_summary.sections_to_improve,
            overall_coverage=result.overall_summary.overall_coverage_percentage,
        )

        global_analysis_cache.set(cache_key, result)
        return result


# ── Pipeline helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────


def _index_comparisons(comparison: ComparisonResult) -> dict[str, SectionComparison]:
    """Build a lookup from section_name → SectionComparison."""
    return {sc.section_name: sc for sc in comparison.sections}


def _find_comparison(
    section: SectionItem | None,
    index: dict[str, SectionComparison],
) -> SectionComparison:
    """Return the SectionComparison for a section."""
    if not section:
        return SectionComparison(
            section_name="unknown",
            matched_keywords=[],
            missing_keywords=[],
            matched_technologies=[],
            missing_technologies=[],
            coverage_percentage=0.0,
        )
    key = section.normalized_name or section.title.lower()
    return index.get(
        key,
        SectionComparison(
            section_name=key,
            matched_keywords=[],
            missing_keywords=[],
            matched_technologies=[],
            missing_technologies=[],
            coverage_percentage=0.0,
        ),
    )


def _build_result(
    document_id: str,
    job_title: str,
    comparison: ComparisonResult,
    reviewed_sections: list[ReviewedSection],
    top_strengths: list[StrengthItem],
    top_improvements: list[ImprovementItem],
) -> ResumeAnalysisResult:
    """Assemble the final result from the merged per-section data."""
    summary = OverallSummary(
        overall_coverage_percentage=comparison.overall_coverage_percentage,
        sections_reviewed=len(reviewed_sections),
        sections_to_improve=sum(1 for s in reviewed_sections if s.review_status == ReviewStatus.IMPROVE),
        job_title=job_title,
    )

    return ResumeAnalysisResult(
        document_id=document_id,
        overall_summary=summary,
        sections=reviewed_sections,
        top_strengths=top_strengths,
        top_improvements=top_improvements,
    )
````

## File: backend/app/services/review_service.py
````python
"""Section and unified review services.

Coordinates calls to the OpenAI Responses API for individual section reviews
and full recruiter-centric resume reviews.
"""

from loguru import logger

from app.ai.provider import OpenAIProvider
from app.ai.review_prompts import REVIEW_INSTRUCTIONS, build_review_input
from app.core.exceptions import BadRequestError
from app.schemas.comparison import ComparisonResult, SectionComparison
from app.schemas.job_description import JobDescription
from app.schemas.review import SectionReview, UnifiedReviewResult
from app.schemas.section import SectionItem


class ReviewService:
    """Runs AI reviews on resumes.

    Exposes two review methods:
    1. Standalone section review (post-compatibility, section by section).
    2. Recruiter-centric unified review (evaluates the entire document at once).
    """

    def __init__(self, provider: OpenAIProvider) -> None:
        self._provider = provider

    def review_resume(
        self,
        sections: list[SectionItem],
        comparison: ComparisonResult,
        job_description: JobDescription,
    ) -> UnifiedReviewResult:
        """Review the entire resume as one document and return consolidated matching details."""
        input_text = build_review_input(
            sections=sections,
            comparison=comparison,
            job_description=job_description,
        )

        result = self._provider.parse_response(
            instructions=REVIEW_INSTRUCTIONS,
            input_text=input_text,
            response_format=UnifiedReviewResult,
            max_output_tokens=2500,
        )

        logger.info(
            "Recruiter unified review complete",
            sections_reviewed=len(result.sections),
            top_strengths=len(result.top_strengths),
            top_improvements=len(result.top_improvements),
        )

        return result

    def review_section(
        self,
        section: SectionItem,
        comparison: SectionComparison,
        job_description: JobDescription,
        full_resume_text: str | None = None,
    ) -> SectionReview:
        """Review one resume section against the job description (standalone fallback)."""
        content = _extract_content_text(section)
        if not content.strip():
            raise BadRequestError(
                f"Section '{section.title}' contains no reviewable text."
            )

        # For standalone single-section review, we reuse the instructions for a single item.
        # Fallback to the same unified schema formatting but parsing a single item.
        from app.ai.review_prompts import build_review_input as build_single_input
        input_text = build_single_input([section], ComparisonResult(
            sections=[comparison],
            matched_skills=[],
            missing_skills=[],
            matched_technologies=[],
            missing_technologies=[],
            keyword_matches=[],
            keyword_gaps=[],
            overall_coverage_percentage=comparison.coverage_percentage
        ), job_description)

        # Parse directly as SectionReview
        result = self._provider.parse_response(
            instructions=REVIEW_INSTRUCTIONS,
            input_text=input_text,
            response_format=SectionReview,
        )

        return result


def _extract_content_text(section: SectionItem) -> str:
    """Return the body text of a section, excluding the heading paragraph."""
    body_paras = [
        p.text
        for p in section.paragraphs
        if p.text.strip().lower() != section.title.strip().lower()
    ]
    return " ".join(body_paras)
````

## File: backend/app/services/tailor_orchestration_service.py
````python
"""Tailor Orchestration Service.

Orchestrates a full-resume AI tailor by calling OpenAIProvider.generate_text()
for summary, experience bullets, and skills. Returns a deep copy of the
StructuredResume with AI-modified content plus a diff map for the preview UI.

The master StructuredResume is NEVER modified.
"""

import copy
from typing import Optional

from loguru import logger

from app.ai.provider import OpenAIProvider
from app.schemas.structured_resume import StructuredResume


TAILOR_SUMMARY_SYSTEM = (
    "You are an executive resume strategist. Rewrite the professional summary to directly align "
    "with the target job title and job description. Frame the narrative around the target role's core "
    "competencies while preserving authentic experience. NEVER fabricate fake companies or degree titles. "
    "Output ONLY the polished summary paragraph (3-4 sentences max) — no headers or preamble."
)

TAILOR_EXPERIENCE_SYSTEM = (
    "You are a master resume editor and ATS optimizer.\n"
    "Rewrite work experience bullet points using the Google XYZ formula ('Accomplished [X] as measured by [Y], by doing [Z]').\n"
    "RULES:\n"
    "1. MANDATORY: Every single bullet point MUST be updated to seamlessly weave in relevant keywords, tools, methodologies, and competencies from the target Job Description (matching the candidate's profession: Tech, Finance, Accounting, Sales, HR, Healthcare, Logistics, Operations, etc.) wherever applicable.\n"
    "2. STRICTLY LOCK & PRESERVE REAL FACTS: Never change company names, job titles, start/end dates, employment years, or locations.\n"
    "3. Output EXACTLY the same number of bullets as input, one line per bullet.\n"
    "4. Do NOT include bullet symbols or preamble — plain text only."
)

TAILOR_SKILLS_SYSTEM = (
    "You are an ATS resume skills optimizer. Categorize and refine the skills section to maximize keyword match against the target job description.\n"
    "RULES:\n"
    "1. Intelligently weave target ATS skills, tools, and domain proficiencies from the job description into appropriate categories.\n"
    "2. Preserve all core existing skills from the original candidate profile.\n"
    "3. Output format must be strictly one line per category: 'CategoryName: Skill1, Skill2, Skill3...'"
)

TAILOR_PROJECTS_SYSTEM = (
    "You are a master resume project strategist. Rewrite project descriptions and bullet points to highlight target methodologies, tools, and quantifiable impact.\n"
    "RULES:\n"
    "1. MANDATORY: Seamlessly weave matching keywords, tools, and standards from the target Job Description into every project bullet point.\n"
    "2. STRICTLY LOCK & PRESERVE REAL FACTS: Never alter project names, company names, repository links, or dates.\n"
    "3. Output EXACTLY the same number of bullets as input, one line per bullet, plain text only."
)


class TailorOrchestrationService:
    """Orchestrates full-resume AI tailoring over a StructuredResume."""

    def __init__(self, ai_provider: OpenAIProvider) -> None:
        self._ai = ai_provider

    def tailor_full_resume(
        self,
        master_resume: StructuredResume,
        job_description: str,
        job_title: str,
    ) -> tuple:
        """Tailor a full StructuredResume for a job description.

        Returns:
            (tailored_resume: StructuredResume, diff: dict)
            diff = { field_path: {original, tailored, ...} }
        """
        tailored = copy.deepcopy(master_resume)
        diff: dict = {}

        logger.info("Starting full resume tailor", job_title=job_title)

        for i, section in enumerate(tailored.sections):
            if not section.visible:
                continue

            sec_type = section.section_type

            if sec_type == "summary":
                original_text = section.content.get("text", "")
                if original_text and original_text.strip():
                    rewritten = self._rewrite_summary(original_text, job_description, job_title)
                    if rewritten and rewritten.strip() != original_text.strip():
                        diff[f"sections[{i}].summary"] = {
                            "original": original_text,
                            "tailored": rewritten,
                        }
                        tailored.sections[i].content["text"] = rewritten

            elif sec_type == "experience":
                entries = section.content.get("entries", [])
                for j, entry in enumerate(entries):
                    bullets = entry.get("bullets", [])
                    if not bullets:
                        continue
                    role_title = entry.get("job_title", "")
                    company = entry.get("company", "")
                    rewritten_bullets = self._rewrite_experience_bullets(
                        bullets, job_description, job_title, role_title=role_title, company=company
                    )
                    if rewritten_bullets and rewritten_bullets != bullets:
                        diff[f"sections[{i}].experience[{j}].bullets"] = {
                            "original": "\n".join(bullets),
                            "tailored": "\n".join(rewritten_bullets),
                            "company": company,
                            "role": role_title,
                        }
                        tailored.sections[i].content["entries"][j]["bullets"] = rewritten_bullets

            elif sec_type == "skills":
                categories = section.content.get("categories", [])
                if categories:
                    original_skills_text = "\n".join(
                        f"{c.get('category_name', '')}: {', '.join(c.get('skills', []))}"
                        for c in categories
                    )
                    rewritten_text = self._rewrite_skills(
                        original_skills_text, job_description, job_title
                    )
                    if rewritten_text and rewritten_text.strip() != original_skills_text.strip():
                        new_categories = self._parse_skills_text(rewritten_text, categories)
                        diff[f"sections[{i}].skills"] = {
                            "original": original_skills_text,
                            "tailored": rewritten_text,
                        }
                        tailored.sections[i].content["categories"] = new_categories

            elif sec_type == "projects":
                entries = section.content.get("entries", [])
                for j, entry in enumerate(entries):
                    bullets = entry.get("bullets", [])
                    if not bullets:
                        continue
                    proj_name = entry.get("name", "")
                    rewritten_bullets = self._rewrite_project_bullets(
                        bullets, job_description, job_title, project_name=proj_name
                    )
                    if rewritten_bullets and rewritten_bullets != bullets:
                        diff[f"sections[{i}].projects[{j}].bullets"] = {
                            "original": "\n".join(bullets),
                            "tailored": "\n".join(rewritten_bullets),
                            "company": entry.get("name", "Project"),
                            "role": "Project Highlights",
                        }
                        tailored.sections[i].content["entries"][j]["bullets"] = rewritten_bullets

        logger.info("Tailor complete", changes=len(diff))
        return tailored, diff

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Private helpers
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _rewrite_summary(self, original: str, jd: str, job_title: str) -> str:
        user_prompt = (
            f"Target Role: {job_title}\n\n"
            f"Job Description:\n{jd[:3000]}\n\n"
            f"Original Summary:\n{original}\n\n"
            f"Rewrite the summary:"
        )
        try:
            return self._ai.generate_text(TAILOR_SUMMARY_SYSTEM, user_prompt).strip()
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning("Summary rewrite failed", error=str(e))
            return original

    def _rewrite_experience_bullets(
        self, bullets: list, jd: str, job_title: str, role_title: str = "", company: str = ""
    ) -> list:
        if not bullets:
            return bullets
        bullets_text = "\n".join(bullets)
        role_ctx = f"{role_title} @ {company}" if role_title or company else "Experience Role"
        user_prompt = (
            f"Candidate Specific Role: {role_ctx}\n"
            f"Target Applied Role: {job_title}\n\n"
            f"Target Job Description:\n{jd[:2500]}\n\n"
            f"Original Bullets for {role_ctx} ({len(bullets)} bullets):\n{bullets_text}\n\n"
            f"Rewrite these {len(bullets)} bullets specifically for the candidate's experience as {role_ctx}, "
            f"seamlessly weaving in matching technical keywords, action verbs, and impact metrics from the target Job Description. "
            f"Output EXACTLY {len(bullets)} bullets (one per line, no bullet symbols):"
        )
        try:
            response = self._ai.generate_text(TAILOR_EXPERIENCE_SYSTEM, user_prompt, temperature=0.3)
            lines = [
                line.strip().lstrip("•-*– ").strip()
                for line in response.strip().split("\n")
                if line.strip()
            ]
            if len(lines) < len(bullets):
                lines.extend(bullets[len(lines):])
            return lines[: len(bullets)]
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning("Experience bullets rewrite failed", error=str(e))
            return bullets

    def _rewrite_project_bullets(
        self, bullets: list, jd: str, job_title: str, project_name: str = ""
    ) -> list:
        if not bullets:
            return bullets
        bullets_text = "\n".join(bullets)
        proj_ctx = f"Project: {project_name}" if project_name else "Technical Project"
        user_prompt = (
            f"Candidate Specific {proj_ctx}\n"
            f"Target Role: {job_title}\n\n"
            f"Target Job Description:\n{jd[:2500]}\n\n"
            f"Original Project Bullets ({len(bullets)} bullets):\n{bullets_text}\n\n"
            f"Rewrite these {len(bullets)} project bullets specifically for {proj_ctx}, "
            f"seamlessly weaving in matching technical keywords, action verbs, and quantifiable engineering metrics from the target Job Description. "
            f"Output EXACTLY {len(bullets)} bullets (one per line, no bullet symbols):"
        )
        try:
            response = self._ai.generate_text(TAILOR_PROJECTS_SYSTEM, user_prompt, temperature=0.3)
            lines = [
                line.strip().lstrip("•-*– ").strip()
                for line in response.strip().split("\n")
                if line.strip()
            ]
            if len(lines) < len(bullets):
                lines.extend(bullets[len(lines):])
            return lines[: len(bullets)]
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning("Project bullets rewrite failed", error=str(e))
            return bullets

    def _rewrite_skills(self, original_skills_text: str, jd: str, job_title: str) -> str:
        user_prompt = (
            f"Target Role: {job_title}\n\n"
            f"Job Description:\n{jd[:2000]}\n\n"
            f"Original Skills:\n{original_skills_text}\n\n"
            f"Reorder skills to prioritize JD-relevant ones:"
        )
        try:
            return self._ai.generate_text(TAILOR_SKILLS_SYSTEM, user_prompt, temperature=0.2).strip()
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning("Skills rewrite failed", error=str(e))
            return original_skills_text

    def _parse_skills_text(self, skills_text: str, original_categories: list) -> list:
        new_cats = []
        for line in skills_text.strip().split("\n"):
            line = line.strip()
            if not line:
                continue
            if ":" in line:
                cat_name, skills_str = line.split(":", 1)
                skills = [s.strip() for s in skills_str.split(",") if s.strip()]
                new_cats.append({"category_name": cat_name.strip(), "skills": skills})
            else:
                new_cats.append({"category_name": "", "skills": [line]})
        return new_cats if new_cats else original_categories
````

## File: backend/tests/test_admin_auth.py
````python
import sys
import os

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.abspath(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..")))

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app
from app.core.config import get_settings
from app.core.security import create_access_token
from app.core.database import SessionLocal, init_db
from app.models import User

client = TestClient(app)
settings = get_settings()

def test_admin_flow():
    # Run migrations
    init_db()

    # Configure a test ADMIN_SECRET
    settings.ADMIN_SECRET = "test_super_secret_pin_1234"

    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        # Create or fetch test admin user
        admin_user = db.query(User).filter(User.email == "ahbarajaib@gmail.com").first()
        assert admin_user is not None, "Superuser should exist in database"
        assert admin_user.is_admin is True, "Superuser should have is_admin=True"

        # Create or fetch a test regular (non-admin) user
        reg_user = db.query(User).filter(User.email == "regular_test_user@example.com").first()
        if not reg_user:
            reg_user = User(
                email="regular_test_user@example.com",
                is_admin=False,
                credits=15,
                plan_type="free",
                subscription_status="inactive",
            )
            db.add(reg_user)
            db.commit()
            db.refresh(reg_user)
        else:
            reg_user.is_admin = False
            db.commit()
    finally:
        db.close()

    admin_jwt = create_access_token({"sub": "ahbarajaib@gmail.com"})
    reg_jwt = create_access_token({"sub": "regular_test_user@example.com"})

    # 1. Non-admin attempts to verify PIN -> 403 Forbidden
    res = client.post(
        "/api/v1/admin/auth/verify-pin",
        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {reg_jwt}"},
        json={"pin": "test_super_secret_pin_1234"},
    )
    assert res.status_code == 403, f"Expected 403, got {res.status_code}: {res.text}"

    # 2. Admin attempts with wrong PIN -> 401 Unauthorized
    res = client.post(
        "/api/v1/admin/auth/verify-pin",
        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {admin_jwt}"},
        json={"pin": "wrong_pin"},
    )
    assert res.status_code == 401, f"Expected 401, got {res.status_code}: {res.text}"

    # 3. Admin attempts with correct PIN -> 200 OK
    res = client.post(
        "/api/v1/admin/auth/verify-pin",
        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {admin_jwt}"},
        json={"pin": "test_super_secret_pin_1234"},
    )
    assert res.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {res.status_code}: {res.text}"
    data = res.json()
    assert "admin_session_token" in data
    admin_token = data["admin_session_token"]

    # 4. Attempt to access stats without X-Admin-Token -> 401
    res = client.get(
        "/api/v1/admin/stats/overview",
        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {admin_jwt}"},
    )
    assert res.status_code == 401, f"Expected 401, got {res.status_code}: {res.text}"

    # 5. Access stats WITH valid X-Admin-Token -> 200 OK
    res = client.get(
        "/api/v1/admin/stats/overview",
        headers={
            "Authorization": f"Bearer {admin_jwt}",
            "X-Admin-Token": admin_token,
        },
    )
    assert res.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {res.status_code}: {res.text}"
    stats = res.json()
    assert "total_users" in stats
    assert "estimated_mrr_inr" in stats

    # 6. List users
    res = client.get(
        "/api/v1/admin/users",
        headers={
            "Authorization": f"Bearer {admin_jwt}",
            "X-Admin-Token": admin_token,
        },
    )
    assert res.status_code == 200
    users_data = res.json()
    assert "items" in users_data
    assert len(users_data["items"]) > 0

    # 7. Check config
    res = client.get(
        "/api/v1/admin/config",
        headers={
            "Authorization": f"Bearer {admin_jwt}",
            "X-Admin-Token": admin_token,
        },
    )
    assert res.status_code == 200
    config_data = res.json()
    assert "FREE_TIER_CREDITS" in config_data["configs"]

    print("✅ All backend admin tests passed successfully!")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_admin_flow()
````

## File: docs/DEPLOYMENT.md

````markdown
# Production Deployment Guide

This document describes how to deploy, manage, and scale the **RoleCraft** application in a production environment.

---

## 1. Docker Deployment

We containerize both the FastAPI backend and Next.js frontend to ensure consistency across staging and production environments.

### Dockerfile (Backend)
Save the following as `backend/Dockerfile`:
```dockerfile
FROM python:3.13-slim-bookworm

ENV PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 \
    PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 \
    PORT=8000

WORKDIR /app

RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

COPY --from=ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:latest /uv /bin/uv

COPY pyproject.toml uv.lock ./
RUN uv sync --frozen --no-dev

COPY . .

EXPOSE 8000

CMD ["uv", "run", "uvicorn", "main:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8000"]
```

### Dockerfile (Frontend)
Save the following as `frontend/Dockerfile`:
```dockerfile
FROM node:20-alpine AS builder

WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci

COPY . .
ENV NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=https://api.rolecraft.tech
RUN npm run build

FROM node:20-alpine AS runner
WORKDIR /app
ENV NODE_ENV=production
COPY --from=builder /app/package*.json ./
COPY --from=builder /app/.next ./.next
COPY --from=builder /app/public ./public
RUN npm ci --only=production

EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["npm", "run", "start"]
```

> **Note**: In our live production environment, the Next.js frontend is hosted serverless on **Vercel** (`rolecraft.tech`), while the FastAPI backend runs in Docker on the Ubuntu VPS (`api.rolecraft.tech`). Refer to [`DEPLOYMENT.md`](../DEPLOYMENT.md) for the active production deployment runbook.

---

## 2. Environment Variables

Create a secure `.env` file in production with the following configurations.

### Backend Configurations
| Variable | Value/Type | Purpose |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `APP_NAME` | `RoleCraft` | Branding name |
| `ENVIRONMENT` | `production` | Enables/disables swagger docs |
| `DEBUG` | `false` | Disables debug stacktraces |
| `LOG_LEVEL` | `INFO` | Central loguru level |
| `ALLOWED_ORIGINS` | `["https://rolecraft.tech","https://admin.rolecraft.tech"]` | CORS restrict policy |
| `UPLOAD_DIR` | `/data/uploads` | Mounted volume folder |
| `MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE_BYTES`| `5242880` | 5 MB upload boundary |
| `GENERATED_CLEANUP_HOURS`| `24` | Automated cleanup interval |
| `OPENAI_API_KEY` | `sk-proj-...` | Production OpenAI API Key |
| `OPENAI_MODEL` | `gpt-4o-mini` | Production LLM model |
| `OPENAI_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | `30.0` | API query timeout limit |
| `JWT_SECRET` | `...` | Secret key for JWT signing |
| `ADMIN_SECRET` | `...` | Secret PIN for Admin Portal Layer 2 |
| `RAZORPAY_KEY_ID` | `rzp_live_...` | Razorpay billing key |
| `RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET` | `...` | Razorpay billing secret |

---

## 3. Production Startup (Docker Compose)

Save the following as `docker-compose.yml` in the root:
```yaml
version: '3.8'

services:
  backend:
    build: ./backend
    restart: always
    environment:
      - ENVIRONMENT=production
      - OPENAI_API_KEY=${OPENAI_API_KEY}
      - JWT_SECRET=${JWT_SECRET}
      - ADMIN_SECRET=${ADMIN_SECRET}
      - UPLOAD_DIR=/data/uploads
      - GENERATED_CLEANUP_HOURS=24
      - ALLOWED_ORIGINS=["https://rolecraft.tech","https://admin.rolecraft.tech"]
    volumes:
      - uploads_data:/data/uploads
      - ./data:/data
    ports:
      - "8000:8000"

volumes:
  uploads_data:
```

---

## 4. Reverse Proxy Example (Nginx)

Nginx sits at the edge, handles SSL termination, and routes requests to the respective frontend/backend containers.

```nginx
# HTTPS Frontend (if self-hosted instead of Vercel)
server {
    listen 443 ssl http2;
    server_name rolecraft.tech;

    ssl_certificate /etc/letsencrypt/live/rolecraft.tech/fullchain.pem;
    ssl_certificate_key /etc/letsencrypt/live/rolecraft.tech/privkey.pem;

    location / {
        proxy_pass http://localhost:3000;
        proxy_http_version 1.1;
        proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;
        proxy_set_header Connection 'upgrade';
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_cache_bypass $http_upgrade;
    }
}

# HTTPS Backend API
server {
    listen 443 ssl http2;
    server_name api.rolecraft.tech;

    ssl_certificate /etc/letsencrypt/live/api.rolecraft.tech/fullchain.pem;
    ssl_certificate_key /etc/letsencrypt/live/api.rolecraft.tech/privkey.pem;

    # Restrict maximum upload sizes at reverse-proxy level to match application configs
    client_max_body_size 5M;

    location / {
        proxy_pass http://localhost:8000;
        proxy_http_version 1.1;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header X-Request-ID $request_id; # Correlates client-proxy tracing
    }
}
```

---

## 5. Database & Volume Backup Strategy

The persistent SQLite database is stored on the host at `./data/rolecraft.db` (mounted into `/data/rolecraft.db` in Docker), and temporary uploads are at `./uploads` / `/data/uploads`.

### Backup Policy
1. **SQLite Database Backup**:
   Use SQLite's safe online backup or a daily snapshot:
   ```bash
   # Safe online backup while container is running
   sqlite3 /opt/role_craft/data/rolecraft.db ".backup '/backups/rolecraft_$(date +%F).db'"
   ```
2. **Automated cleanup retention**:
   Uploaded files older than 24 hours are automatically pruned by the backend. Retain daily DB backups for 30 days:
   ```bash
   find /backups/ -name "rolecraft_*.db" -mtime +30 -delete
   ```

---

## 6. Admin Dashboard Subdomain (`admin.rolecraft.tech`) Setup

The admin control panel is hosted completely isolated from normal users at `admin.rolecraft.tech`.

### 1. DNS Record
- Add an **`A` record** in your domain DNS:
  - Host: `admin`
  - IP: Your VPS IP (same as `rolecraft.tech`)

### 2. Environment Variable
Generate a strong secret key:
```bash
openssl rand -hex 16
```
Add to `backend/.env`:
```env
ADMIN_SECRET="your-generated-secret"
```

### 3. Caddy or Nginx Reverse Proxy
**Caddy (`/etc/caddy/Caddyfile`)**:
```caddy
admin.rolecraft.tech {
    header X-Robots-Tag "noindex, nofollow"
    rewrite * /xrc-control{uri}
    reverse_proxy localhost:3000
}
```

**Nginx**:
```nginx
server {
    server_name admin.rolecraft.tech;
    add_header X-Robots-Tag "noindex, nofollow" always;
    location / {
        rewrite ^(.*)$ /xrc-control$1 break;
        proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:3000;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
    }
}
```

### 4. Bootstrap Superuser
```bash
cd backend
python scripts/bootstrap_admin.py
```
````

## File: frontend/src/app/xrc-control/page.tsx
````typescript
"use client";

import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { ShieldCheck, Lock, ArrowRight, KeyRound, AlertCircle, Loader2, CheckCircle2, ChevronLeft } from "lucide-react";
import { loginAdminStep1, verifyAdminPinStep2, isAdminLoggedIn, clearAdminSession } from "@/lib/admin-api";

export default function AdminLoginPage() {
  const router = useRouter();

  const [step, setStep] = useState<1 | 2>(1);
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [pin, setPin] = useState("");
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [successMessage, setSuccessMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // If already logged in, redirect directly to dashboard
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isAdminLoggedIn()) {
      router.replace("/xrc-control/dashboard");
    }
  }, [router]);

  const handleStep1Login = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setErrorMessage(null);
    setSuccessMessage(null);

    if (!email.trim() || !password) {
      setErrorMessage("Please enter both email and password.");
      return;
    }

    setIsLoading(true);
    try {
      await loginAdminStep1(email.trim(), password);
      setSuccessMessage("Credentials verified. Enter Admin Secret PIN.");
      setStep(2);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Authentication failed.";
      setErrorMessage(message);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleStep2PinVerify = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setErrorMessage(null);

    if (!pin.trim()) {
      setErrorMessage("Please enter your Admin Secret PIN.");
      return;
    }

    setIsLoading(true);
    try {
      await verifyAdminPinStep2(pin.trim());
      setSuccessMessage("Authentication successful. Redirecting to control panel...");
      setTimeout(() => {
        router.push("/xrc-control/dashboard");
      }, 500);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Invalid Admin PIN.";
      setErrorMessage(message);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleReset = () => {
    clearAdminSession();
    setStep(1);
    setPin("");
    setPassword("");
    setErrorMessage(null);
    setSuccessMessage(null);
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen flex flex-col justify-center items-center px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 bg-gradient-to-b from-slate-50 to-slate-100">
      <div className="w-full max-w-md">
        {/* Header Branding */}
        <div className="text-center mb-8">
          <div className="inline-flex items-center justify-center w-14 h-14 rounded-2xl bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-lg shadow-indigo-200 mb-4">
            <ShieldCheck className="w-7 h-7" />
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900">
            RoleCraft Control Center
          </h1>
          <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">
            {step === 1
              ? "Layer 1: Administrator Credentials"
              : "Layer 2: Secret PIN Verification"}
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Card */}
        <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl shadow-slate-200/60 border border-slate-200/80 p-8">
          {/* Status Messages */}
          {errorMessage && (
            <div className="mb-6 p-4 rounded-xl bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 text-rose-800 text-sm flex items-start gap-3">
              <AlertCircle className="w-5 h-5 flex-shrink-0 text-rose-600 mt-0.5" />
              <div className="font-medium leading-relaxed">{errorMessage}</div>
            </div>
          )}

          {successMessage && !errorMessage && (
            <div className="mb-6 p-4 rounded-xl bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 text-emerald-800 text-sm flex items-center gap-3">
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 flex-shrink-0 text-emerald-600" />
              <div className="font-medium">{successMessage}</div>
            </div>
          )}

          {step === 1 ? (
            /* STEP 1: Email + Password */
            <form onSubmit={handleStep1Login} className="space-y-5">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-600 mb-2">
                  Admin Email
                </label>
                <input
                  type="email"
                  required
                  autoFocus
                  autoComplete="email"
                  value={email}
                  onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="admin@rolecraft.tech"
                  className="w-full px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/50 text-slate-900 placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:bg-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:border-transparent transition-all text-sm"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-600 mb-2">
                  Password
                </label>
                <input
                  type="password"
                  required
                  autoComplete="current-password"
                  value={password}
                  onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="••••••••••••"
                  className="w-full px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/50 text-slate-900 placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:bg-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:border-transparent transition-all text-sm font-mono"
                />
              </div>

              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={isLoading}
                className="w-full mt-2 py-3 px-4 rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 active:bg-indigo-800 text-white font-medium text-sm shadow-md shadow-indigo-200 transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2 disabled:opacity-60 disabled:cursor-not-allowed cursor-pointer"
              >
                {isLoading ? (
                  <>
                    <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
                    <span>Verifying credentials...</span>
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <span>Next: PIN Verification</span>
                    <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4" />
                  </>
                )}
              </button>
            </form>
          ) : (
            /* STEP 2: Secret PIN Verification */
            <form onSubmit={handleStep2PinVerify} className="space-y-5">
              <div className="p-3 bg-slate-50 rounded-xl border border-slate-200/80 text-xs text-slate-600 flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="truncate font-medium text-slate-800">{email}</span>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleReset}
                  className="text-indigo-600 hover:text-indigo-700 font-medium ml-2 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Change
                </button>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-600 mb-2">
                  Admin Secret PIN
                </label>
                <div className="relative">
                  <input
                    type="password"
                    required
                    autoFocus
                    autoComplete="one-time-code"
                    value={pin}
                    onChange={(e) => setPin(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Enter your 16+ character PIN"
                    className="w-full px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/50 text-slate-900 placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:bg-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:border-transparent transition-all text-sm font-mono tracking-wider"
                  />
````

````typescript
interface DailyGoalCardProps {

  onHide?: () => void;

export function DailyGoalCard({
  dailyGoal,
  onUpdateTarget,
  isUpdatingTarget = false,
  onOpenHistory,

  const percentage = Math.min(100, Math.round(dailyGoal.progress_percentage || 0));
````

````typescript
"use client";

import { useAuth } from "./auth_provider";
import { downloadExtensionZip } from "@/lib/api";

  X,
  Download,
  CheckCircle2,
  Sparkles,
  Lock,
  ExternalLink,
  ShieldCheck,
  Zap,

interface ExtensionModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onOpenSubscribe?: () => void;
  onOpenPreview?: () => void;
}

export default function ExtensionModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onOpenSubscribe,
  onOpenPreview,
}: ExtensionModalProps) {
  const { user, token } = useAuth();
  const [isDownloading, setIsDownloading] = useState(false);
  const [downloadSuccess, setDownloadSuccess] = useState(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const planType = (user?.plan_type || "free").toLowerCase();
  const isProOrElite =
    planType === "pro" ||
    planType === "elite" ||
    user?.subscription_status === "active";

  const handleDownload = async () => {
    if (!token) {
      setErrorMessage("Please log in to download the extension.");
      return;
    }
    try {
      setIsDownloading(true);
      setErrorMessage(null);
      const blob = await downloadExtensionZip(token);
      
      // Trigger browser download
      const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = url;
      a.download = "rolecraft-linkedin-copier.zip";
      document.body.appendChild(a);
      a.click();
      window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      document.body.removeChild(a);

      setDownloadSuccess(true);
      setTimeout(() => setDownloadSuccess(false), 5000);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMessage(err.message || "Failed to download extension archive.");
    } finally {
      setIsDownloading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-slate-900/60 backdrop-blur-xs animate-in fade-in duration-200">

          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="absolute top-5 right-5 p-1.5 rounded-full bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 text-slate-300 hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            aria-label="Close modal"
          >
            <X className="h-5 w-5" />
          </button>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="h-11 w-11 rounded-2xl bg-teal-500/20 border border-teal-400/40 flex items-center justify-center shadow-inner">
              <Zap className="h-6 w-6 text-teal-300" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <h2 className="text-lg sm:text-xl font-black tracking-tight">
                  LinkedIn 1-Click Job Copier
                </h2>
                {isProOrElite ? (
                  <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-teal-500/20 border border-teal-400/40 text-teal-200 text-[10px] font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider">
                    ✦ Pro Active

                ) : (
                  <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-amber-500/20 border border-amber-400/40 text-amber-200 text-[10px] font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1">
                    <Lock className="h-2.5 w-2.5" /> Pro Exclusive

          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Modal Body */}
        <div className="p-6 sm:p-7 overflow-y-auto space-y-6">
          {errorMessage && (
            <div className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-red-50 border border-red-200 text-red-700 text-xs flex items-start gap-2.5">
````
