## File: frontend/src/components/issue_report_modal.tsx
````typescript
"use client";

import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import {
  X,
  Send,
  AlertCircle,
  CheckCircle2,
  Bug,
  FileText,
  Sparkles,
  CreditCard,
  Lightbulb,
  MessageSquare,
  Loader2,
  HelpCircle,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useAuth } from "./auth_provider";

const rawApiUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || "http://localhost:8000";
const API_BASE_URL = rawApiUrl.replace(/\/api\/v1\/?$/, "");

export interface IssueReportModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  initialCategory?: "bug" | "formatting" | "ai_quality" | "payment" | "feature_request" | "general";
  initialError?: string | null;
  activeDocumentId?: string | null;
}

const CATEGORIES = [
  { id: "bug", label: "Bug / Error", icon: Bug, desc: "Something broke or crashed" },
  { id: "formatting", label: "Formatting", icon: FileText, desc: "DOCX or PDF layout issue" },
  { id: "ai_quality", label: "AI Output", icon: Sparkles, desc: "Low quality or inaccurate rewrite" },
  { id: "payment", label: "Credits / Billing", icon: CreditCard, desc: "Subscription or balance issue" },
  { id: "feature_request", label: "Feature Idea", icon: Lightbulb, desc: "Suggest an improvement" },
  { id: "general", label: "General", icon: MessageSquare, desc: "Other feedback or question" },
] as const;

export default function IssueReportModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  initialCategory = "bug",
  initialError = null,
  activeDocumentId = null,
}: IssueReportModalProps) {
  const { user, token } = useAuth();
  const [category, setCategory] = useState<string>(initialCategory);
  const [subject, setSubject] = useState("");
  const [description, setDescription] = useState("");
  const [contactEmail, setContactEmail] = useState("");
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [submitError, setSubmitError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isSuccess, setIsSuccess] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      setCategory(initialCategory);
      setSubmitError(null);
      setIsSuccess(false);
      if (user?.email) {
        setContactEmail(user.email);
      }
      if (initialError) {
        setSubject("Error encountered during operation");
        setDescription(`I encountered the following issue:\n${initialError}`);
      }
    }
  }, [isOpen, initialCategory, initialError, user]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!description.trim() || description.trim().length < 5) {
      setSubmitError("Please provide a bit more detail (at least 5 characters).");
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);
    setSubmitError(null);

    // Auto-capture technical diagnostics
    const diagnostics = {
      url: typeof window !== "undefined" ? window.location.href : "",
      user_agent: typeof navigator !== "undefined" ? navigator.userAgent : "",
      screen_size: typeof window !== "undefined" ? `${window.innerWidth}x${window.innerHeight}` : "",
      active_document_id: activeDocumentId || user?.base_resume_id || null,
      initial_error_context: initialError || null,
      timestamp_local: new Date().toISOString(),
    };

    try {
      const headers: Record<string, string> = {
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
      };
      if (token) {
        headers["Authorization"] = `Bearer ${token}`;
      }

      const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/api/v1/support/report-issue`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers,
        body: JSON.stringify({
          issue_type: category,
          subject: subject.trim() || undefined,
          description: description.trim(),
          user_email: contactEmail.trim() || undefined,
          context_data: diagnostics,
        }),
      });

      if (!response.ok) {
        const errData = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
        throw new Error(errData.detail || "Failed to submit report. Please try again.");
      }

      setIsSuccess(true);
      setTimeout(() => {
        setDescription("");
        setSubject("");
        setIsSuccess(false);
        onClose();
      }, 2500);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setSubmitError(err.message || "Failed to submit report. Please try again.");
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[1050] flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-4 bg-slate-900/50 backdrop-blur-sm animate-fade-in">
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-lg rounded-3xl p-5 sm:p-7 border border-teal-100 bg-white shadow-2xl flex flex-col space-y-5 max-h-[92vh] overflow-y-auto">
        {/* Close Button */}
        <button
          onClick={onClose}
          className="absolute top-4 right-4 p-1.5 rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-100 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
        >
          <X className="h-4 w-4" />
        </button>

        {isSuccess ? (
          <div className="py-8 text-center space-y-4 animate-fade-in-up">
            <div className="h-14 w-14 rounded-2xl bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-600 border border-emerald-200 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto shadow-sm">
              <CheckCircle2 className="h-8 w-8" />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <h3 className="text-lg font-black text-slate-900">Issue Report Received</h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 max-w-xs mx-auto">
                Thank you for helping us improve RoleCraft. Our engineering team has been notified via email.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <>
            {/* Header */}
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-teal-50 border border-teal-200 text-teal-700 text-[10px] font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider">
                <HelpCircle className="h-3 w-3" />
                Support &amp; Feedback
              </div>
              <h2 className="text-xl font-black text-slate-900 tracking-tight">
                Report an Issue or Feedback
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 font-medium">
                Encountered a problem or have an idea? Let us know and we'll look into it immediately.
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* Error banner */}
            {submitError && (
              <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-red-50 border border-red-200 text-red-700 text-xs flex items-start gap-2 animate-fade-in-up">
                <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                <span>{submitError}</span>
              </div>
            )}

            <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
              {/* Category Chips */}
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider">
                  Category
                </label>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-1.5 sm:gap-2">
                  {CATEGORIES.map((cat) => {
                    const Icon = cat.icon;
                    const isSelected = category === cat.id;
                    return (
                      <button
                        key={cat.id}
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setCategory(cat.id)}
                        className={`p-2.5 rounded-xl border text-left flex flex-col justify-between transition-all cursor-pointer select-none ${
                          isSelected
                            ? "border-teal-600 bg-teal-50/70 text-[#0F172A] ring-1 ring-teal-500/30 shadow-xs"
                            : "border-slate-200 bg-white hover:border-teal-200 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50/50"
                        }`}
                      >
                        <Icon className={`h-4 w-4 mb-1 ${isSelected ? "text-teal-600" : "text-slate-400"}`} />
                        <span className="text-xs font-bold leading-tight truncate">{cat.label}</span>
                      </button>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Subject Title */}
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider">
                  Subject <span className="text-slate-400 font-normal">(Optional)</span>
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={subject}
                  onChange={(e) => setSubject(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="e.g. DOCX alignment issue in summary"
                  className="w-full bg-slate-50 text-slate-900 border border-slate-200 focus:border-teal-500 rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs focus:outline-none transition-all"
                  disabled={isSubmitting}
                />
              </div>

              {/* Description */}
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider">
                  Description <span className="text-rose-500">*</span>
                </label>
                <textarea
                  rows={4}
                  value={description}
                  onChange={(e) => setDescription(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Describe what happened, what you were doing, or your suggestion..."
                  className="w-full bg-slate-50 text-slate-900 border border-slate-200 focus:border-teal-500 rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs focus:outline-none transition-all resize-none leading-relaxed"
                  disabled={isSubmitting}
                  required
                />
              </div>

              {/* Contact Email (for replies) */}
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider">
                  Your Email <span className="text-slate-400 font-normal">(Optional for follow-up)</span>
                </label>
                <input
                  type="email"
                  value={contactEmail}
                  onChange={(e) => setContactEmail(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="you@example.com"
                  className="w-full bg-slate-50 text-slate-900 border border-slate-200 focus:border-teal-500 rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs focus:outline-none transition-all"
                  disabled={isSubmitting}
                />
              </div>

              {/* Auto-captured diagnostics info notice */}
              <div className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200/80 text-[11px] text-slate-500 flex items-center gap-2">
                <Sparkles className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-teal-500 shrink-0" />
                <span>Technical details (browser, active document, error codes) will be attached automatically.</span>
              </div>

              {/* Submit CTA */}
              <div className="pt-2 flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={onClose}
                  className="px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 font-bold text-xs transition-all cursor-pointer"
                  disabled={isSubmitting}
                >
                  Cancel
                </button>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={isSubmitting}
                  className="btn-primary px-5 py-2.5 text-xs flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
                >
                  {isSubmitting ? (
                    <>
                      <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" />
                      <span>Sending...</span>
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      <Send className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                      <span>Submit Report</span>
                    </>
                  )}
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
````

## File: frontend/src/components/parsing_progress_card.tsx
````typescript
import React, { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Sparkles, CheckCircle2, Loader2, FileText, Code, Briefcase, GraduationCap, FolderGit2 } from "lucide-react";

const PARSE_STEPS = [
  { label: "Extracting raw text from document", sub: "Reading headers, tables, bullet formatting...", icon: FileText },
  { label: "Parsing Contact Details & Summary", sub: "Extracting name, headline, email, phone, location...", icon: Sparkles },
  { label: "Categorizing Technical Skills", sub: "Grouping frameworks, languages & databases...", icon: Code },
  { label: "Structuring Work Experience", sub: "Extracting roles, companies, dates & achievements...", icon: Briefcase },
  { label: "Parsing Projects & Education", sub: "Extracting project URLs, descriptions & degrees...", icon: FolderGit2 },
  { label: "Synthesizing Master Resume", sub: "Generating ATS structured JSON record...", icon: GraduationCap },
];

export function ParsingProgressCard({ fileName }: { fileName?: string }) {
  const [stepIndex, setStepIndex] = useState(0);
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState(12);

  useEffect(() => {
    const stepTimer = setInterval(() => {
      setStepIndex((prev) => {
        if (prev < PARSE_STEPS.length - 1) return prev + 1;
        return prev;
      });
    }, 3800);

    const progressTimer = setInterval(() => {
      setProgress((prev) => {
        if (prev < 94) return prev + Math.floor(Math.random() * 2) + 1;
        return prev;
      });
    }, 450);

    return () => {
      clearInterval(stepTimer);
      clearInterval(progressTimer);
    };
  }, []);

  const currentStep = PARSE_STEPS[stepIndex];

  return (
    <div className="p-8 sm:p-12 rounded-3xl bg-white border border-teal-200 shadow-2xl shadow-teal-500/10 text-center max-w-xl mx-auto space-y-6 my-8 relative overflow-hidden">
      {/* Background Animated Glow */}
      <div className="absolute -top-24 -left-24 w-48 h-48 bg-teal-500/10 rounded-full blur-3xl animate-pulse" />
      <div className="absolute -bottom-24 -right-24 w-48 h-48 bg-cyan-500/10 rounded-full blur-3xl animate-pulse" />

      {/* Center Glowing Ring Graphic */}
      <div className="relative h-20 w-20 mx-auto flex items-center justify-center">
        <div className="absolute inset-0 rounded-3xl bg-gradient-to-tr from-blue-600 via-cyan-500 to-blue-500 animate-spin blur-sm opacity-70" style={{ animationDuration: "6s" }} />
        <div className="relative h-16 w-16 rounded-2xl bg-slate-900 flex items-center justify-center text-white shadow-xl">
          <Sparkles className="h-8 w-8 text-cyan-300 animate-pulse" />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Step Info Header */}
      <div className="space-y-2 relative z-10">
        <span className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-teal-700 bg-teal-50 px-3 py-1 rounded-full border border-teal-200 inline-block">
          {fileName ? `Parsing ${fileName}` : "AI Resume Parsing in Progress"}
        </span>
        <h3 className="text-lg font-extrabold text-slate-900 flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
          <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin text-teal-600" />
          {currentStep.label}
        </h3>
        <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 max-w-md mx-auto">
          {currentStep.sub}
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* Shimmer Progress Bar & % Counter */}
      <div className="space-y-2 relative z-10">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-bold text-slate-600 px-1">
          <span>Parsing Progress</span>
          <span className="text-teal-600 font-extrabold">{progress}%</span>
        </div>
        <div className="w-full bg-slate-100 h-3 rounded-full overflow-hidden p-0.5 border border-slate-200">
          <div
            className="bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 via-cyan-400 to-teal-600 h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-300 relative overflow-hidden"
            style={{ width: `${progress}%` }}
          >
            <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-white/20 animate-pulse" />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Live Step Checklist */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-left pt-2 relative z-10">
        {PARSE_STEPS.slice(0, 4).map((step, idx) => {
          const isDone = idx < stepIndex;
          const isCurrent = idx === stepIndex;
          return (
            <div
              key={idx}
              className={`p-2.5 rounded-xl border text-[11px] font-medium flex items-center gap-2 transition-all ${
                isDone
                  ? "bg-emerald-50/60 border-emerald-200 text-emerald-700"
                  : isCurrent
                  ? "bg-teal-50/60 border-teal-300 text-teal-700 shadow-sm"
                  : "bg-slate-50/40 border-slate-200 text-slate-400"
              }`}
            >
              {isDone ? (
                <CheckCircle2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-emerald-500 shrink-0" />
              ) : isCurrent ? (
                <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-teal-600 animate-spin shrink-0" />
              ) : (
                <div className="h-3.5 w-3.5 rounded-full border border-slate-300 shrink-0" />
              )}
              <span className="truncate">{step.label.replace("Extracting raw text from document", "Raw Text Extraction")}</span>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````typescript
"use client";

  X,
  User as UserIcon,

interface ProfileModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  user: any;
  token: string | null;
  onProfileUpdated: () => void;
}

export function ProfileModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  user,
  token,
  onProfileUpdated,
}: ProfileModalProps) {
  const [name, setName] = useState(user?.name || "");
  const [phoneNumber, setPhoneNumber] = useState(user?.phone_number || "");
  const [address, setAddress] = useState(user?.address || "");
  const [linkedinUrl, setLinkedinUrl] = useState(user?.linkedin_url || "");

  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);
  const [isUploadingCl, setIsUploadingCl] = useState(false);
  const [isDeletingCl, setIsDeletingCl] = useState(false);
  const [isClearingSkills, setIsClearingSkills] = useState(false);
  const [copiedSkill, setCopiedSkill] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [statusMsg, setStatusMsg] = useState<{ type: "success" | "error"; text: string } | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (user) {
      setName(user.name || "");
      setPhoneNumber(user.phone_number || "");
      setAddress(user.address || "");
      setLinkedinUrl(user.linkedin_url || "");
    }
  }, [user]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  // Calculate live profile completion score
  const completion = calculateProfileCompletion({
    ...user,
    name,
    phone_number: phoneNumber,
    address,
    linkedin_url: linkedinUrl,
  });

  const handleSaveProfile = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setIsSaving(true);
    setStatusMsg(null);
    try {
      await updateProfile({
        name,
        phone_number: phoneNumber,
        address,
        linkedin_url: linkedinUrl,
      });
      setStatusMsg({ type: "success", text: "Profile contact details saved successfully!" });
      onProfileUpdated();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setStatusMsg({ type: "error", text: err?.message || "Failed to update profile." });
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleBaseCoverLetterUpload = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    if (!file.name.endsWith(".docx")) {
      setStatusMsg({ type: "error", text: "Only Word (.docx) cover letter templates are supported." });
      return;
    }
    setIsUploadingCl(true);
    setStatusMsg(null);
    try {
      const uploadRes = await uploadResume(file);
      await setBaseCoverLetter(uploadRes.document_id, file.name);
      setStatusMsg({ type: "success", text: "Base cover letter template uploaded and saved!" });
      onProfileUpdated();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setStatusMsg({ type: "error", text: err?.message || "Failed to upload cover letter template." });
    } finally {
      setIsUploadingCl(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteBaseCoverLetter = async () => {
    if (!confirm("Are you sure you want to remove your saved base cover letter template?")) return;
    setIsDeletingCl(true);
    setStatusMsg(null);
    try {
      await deleteBaseCoverLetter();
      setStatusMsg({ type: "success", text: "Base cover letter template removed." });
      onProfileUpdated();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setStatusMsg({ type: "error", text: err?.message || "Failed to remove cover letter template." });
    } finally {
      setIsDeletingCl(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-slate-900/60 backdrop-blur-sm animate-fade-in">
      <div
        className="fixed inset-0"
        onClick={onClose}
      />
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-2xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 shadow-2xl overflow-hidden z-10 flex flex-col max-h-[90vh]">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-6 py-4 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-slate-900/50">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="h-10 w-10 rounded-2xl bg-teal-500/10 border border-teal-500/20 flex items-center justify-center text-teal-600 dark:text-teal-400">
              <UserIcon className="h-5 w-5" />

            <div>
              <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                Profile & Central Base Documents
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                Manage contact info and master templates stored centrally for your applications
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-2 rounded-xl text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-all cursor-pointer"
          >
            <X className="h-4 w-4" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Content Body */}
        <div className="p-6 space-y-6 overflow-y-auto flex-1 text-sm">
          {/* Profile Completion Progress Card */}
          <div className="p-4 rounded-2xl border border-teal-500/30 dark:border-teal-500/20 bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-500/5 via-purple-500/5 to-emerald-500/5 dark:from-indigo-950/20 dark:to-emerald-950/20 space-y-3 shadow-sm">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Sparkles className="h-4 w-4 text-teal-500 animate-pulse" />
                <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white uppercase tracking-wider">
                  Profile Completion Score

                    }`}
````
