````typescript
                    type="text"
                    value={phoneNumber}
                    onChange={(e) => setPhoneNumber(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="e.g. (313) 555-0100"
                    className="w-full pl-9 pr-3 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/60 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-teal-500"
                  />
                  <Phone className="h-4 w-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 top-2.5" />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">
                  Location / Address
                </label>
                <div className="relative">
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={address}
                    onChange={(e) => setAddress(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="e.g. Carson City, NV | Seattle, WA"
                    className="w-full pl-9 pr-3 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/60 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-teal-500"
                  />
                  <MapPin className="h-4 w-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 top-2.5" />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">
                  LinkedIn URL / Portfolio
                </label>
                <div className="relative">
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={linkedinUrl}
                    onChange={(e) => setLinkedinUrl(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="e.g. linkedin.com/in/danielle"
                    className="w-full pl-9 pr-3 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/60 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-teal-500"
                  />
                  <Globe className="h-4 w-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 top-2.5" />
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="p-3 bg-teal-500/5 border border-teal-500/10 rounded-2xl text-[11px] text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 flex items-start gap-2">
              <Info className="h-4 w-4 text-teal-500 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              <span>
                <strong>Cover Letter Auto-Format Header preview:</strong>
                <br />
                {name || "YOUR NAME"} • {address || "Location"} | {phoneNumber || "Phone"} | {user?.email} | {linkedinUrl || "LinkedIn"}
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="flex justify-end pt-2">
              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={isSaving}
                className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 bg-teal-600 hover:bg-teal-500 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all shadow-md shadow-teal-600/20 cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
              >
                <Save className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                {isSaving ? "Saving..." : "Save Contact Info"}
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>

          {/* Central Base Documents Storage */}
          <div className="space-y-4 pt-4 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800">
            <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-2">
              <FileText className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-emerald-500" />
              Central Base Master Documents
            </h3>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              {/* Base Resume Storage Card */}
              <div className="p-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-slate-800/40 space-y-3">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <WordLogoIcon className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
                    Master Base Resume (.docx)
                  </span>
                  {user?.base_resume_id ? (
                    <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-extrabold text-[10px] flex items-center gap-1">
                      <CheckCircle className="h-3 w-3" /> Saved
                    </span>
                  ) : (
                    <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-700 text-slate-500 text-[10px]">
                      Not uploaded
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>

                {user?.base_resume_filename ? (
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 p-2.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-xs truncate text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                    <WordLogoIcon className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
                    <span className="truncate">{user.base_resume_filename}</span>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 leading-relaxed">
                    Upload your master resume in the workspace to save it centrally here.
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* Base Cover Letter Storage Card */}
              <div className="p-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-slate-800/40 space-y-3">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <WordLogoIcon className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
                    Base Cover Letter (.docx)
                  </span>
                  {user?.base_cover_letter_id ? (
                    <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-extrabold text-[10px] flex items-center gap-1">
                      <CheckCircle className="h-3 w-3" /> Template Active
                    </span>
                  ) : (
                    <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 font-bold text-[10px]">
                      Using Default Style
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>

                {user?.base_cover_letter_filename ? (
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-2.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-xs truncate text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 truncate">
                      <WordLogoIcon className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
                      <span className="truncate">{user.base_cover_letter_filename}</span>
                    </div>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={handleDeleteBaseCoverLetter}
                      disabled={isDeletingCl}
                      className="p-1 text-slate-400 hover:text-red-500 transition-colors ml-2 cursor-pointer"
                      title="Remove cover letter template"
                    >
                      <Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 leading-relaxed">
                    Upload your custom Word cover letter template to preserve your custom formatting.
                  </p>
                )}

                <label className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 w-full py-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold text-teal-600 dark:text-teal-400 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-sm">
                  <WordLogoIcon className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
                  <span>{isUploadingCl ? "Uploading..." : "Upload Cover Letter Template (.docx)"}</span>
                  <input
                    type="file"
                    accept=".docx"
                    onChange={handleBaseCoverLetterUpload}
                    className="hidden"
                    disabled={isUploadingCl}
                  />
                </label>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Market Skill Gaps Tracker (Red Skills) */}
          <div className="space-y-4 pt-4 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-2">
                <Target className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-rose-500" />
                Market Skill Gaps Tracker (Red Skills)
              </h3>
              {user?.missing_skills_tracker && Object.keys(user.missing_skills_tracker).length > 0 && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={async () => {
                    if (!confirm("Are you sure you want to clear your recorded market skill gaps?")) return;
                    setIsClearingSkills(true);
                    try {
                      await clearMissingSkills();
                      onProfileUpdated();
                    } catch (err: any) {
                      setStatusMsg({ type: "error", text: err?.message || "Failed to clear skills." });
                    } finally {
                      setIsClearingSkills(false);
                    }
                  }}
                  disabled={isClearingSkills}
                  className="text-[11px] font-bold text-rose-500 hover:text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 hover:underline flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
                >
                  <Trash2 className="h-3 w-3" />
                  {isClearingSkills ? "Clearing..." : "Clear Tracker"}
                </button>
              )}
            </div>

            {user?.missing_skills_tracker && Object.keys(user.missing_skills_tracker).length > 0 ? (
              <div className="p-4 rounded-2xl border border-rose-500/20 bg-rose-500/5 dark:bg-rose-950/20 space-y-3">
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 leading-relaxed">
                  Tracked keywords required by job descriptions you've analyzed that were missing from your resume.
                  Repeated skills show their frequency count next to them (click to copy skill):
                </p>

                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap max-h-48 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
                  {Object.entries(user.missing_skills_tracker as Record<string, number>).map(([skill, count]) => {
                    const isCopied = copiedSkill === skill;
                    return (
                      <button
                        key={skill}
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => {
                          navigator.clipboard.writeText(skill);
                          setCopiedSkill(skill);
                          setTimeout(() => setCopiedSkill(null), 1000);
                        }}
                        className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-extrabold border transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-sm ${
                          isCopied
                            ? "bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 border-emerald-500/40"
                            : "bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300 border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-800 hover:bg-rose-100 dark:hover:bg-rose-950/40"
                        }`}
                        title={`Click to copy '${skill}'`}
                      >
                        {isCopied ? (
                          <Check className="h-3 w-3 text-emerald-500 shrink-0" />
                        ) : (
                          <Target className="h-3 w-3 text-rose-500 shrink-0" />
                        )}
                        <span>{skill}</span>
                        {count > 1 && (
                          <span className="px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full bg-rose-500/20 dark:bg-rose-500/30 text-rose-800 dark:text-rose-200 font-black text-[10px]">
                            ×{count}
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </button>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="p-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-slate-800/40 text-center space-y-1">
                <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                  No missing skills tracked yet.
                </p>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                  Analyze resumes against target job descriptions in your workspace — missing keywords in red will automatically accumulate here with their counts for your reference!
                </p>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
````

## File: frontend/src/components/resume_completion_modal.tsx
````typescript
"use client";

import { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback, useMemo } from "react";
import {
  X, CheckCircle2, AlertCircle, Save, ChevronRight, Loader2,
  User, Mail, Phone, MapPin, Link, GitBranch, Globe, Briefcase, Sparkles, Camera, Trash2,
} from "lucide-react";
import {
  StructuredResume,
  ContactInfo,
  updateStructuredResume,
  uploadProfilePhoto,
  deleteProfilePhoto,
} from "@/lib/structured_resume_api";
import ResumeSectionEditor from "@/components/resume_section_editor";

export function getFullProfilePhotoUrl(url?: string | null): string | null {
  if (!url) return null;
  if (url.startsWith("http://") || url.startsWith("https://") || url.startsWith("data:")) return url;
  const apiHost = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || (typeof window !== "undefined" && window.location.hostname === "localhost" ? "http://localhost:8000" : "https://api.rolecraft.tech");
  return `${apiHost.replace(/\/$/, "")}${url.startsWith("/") ? "" : "/"}${url}`;
}

interface ResumeCompletionModalProps {
  resume: StructuredResume;
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSaved: (updated: StructuredResume) => void;
}

// Compute which fields are still empty/unparsed
function getActiveUnparsedFields(resume: StructuredResume): string[] {
  const raw = resume.parse_confidence?.low_confidence_fields ?? [];
  return raw.filter((fieldPath) => {
    const f = fieldPath.toLowerCase();
    const ci = resume.contact_info;
    if (f.includes("full_name")) return !ci?.full_name?.trim();
    if (f.includes("email")) return !ci?.email?.trim();
    if (f.includes("phone")) return !ci?.phone?.trim();
    if (f.includes("location")) return !ci?.location?.trim();
    if (f.includes("linkedin")) return !ci?.linkedin_url?.trim();
    if (f.includes("portfolio")) return !ci?.portfolio_url?.trim();
    if (f.includes("github")) return !ci?.github_url?.trim();
    if (f.includes("job_title") && f.includes("contact")) return !ci?.job_title?.trim();
    const secMatch = f.match(/sections?\[(\d+)\]/);
    if (secMatch) {
      const idx = parseInt(secMatch[1]);
      const section = resume.sections[idx];
      if (!section) return true;
      const content = section.content;
      if (section.section_type === "experience") {
        const expMatch = f.match(/entries?\[(\d+)\]\.bullets/);
        if (expMatch) {
          const ei = parseInt(expMatch[1]);
          const entry = content?.entries?.[ei];
          return !entry || !entry.bullets || entry.bullets.length === 0;
        }
        const entryMatch = f.match(/entries?\[(\d+)\]\.(\w+)/);
        if (entryMatch) {
          const ei = parseInt(entryMatch[1]);
          const field = entryMatch[2];
          return !content?.entries?.[ei]?.[field]?.trim();
        }
      }
      if (section.section_type === "education") {
        const entryMatch = f.match(/entries?\[(\d+)\]\.(\w+)/);
        if (entryMatch) {
          const ei = parseInt(entryMatch[1]);
          const field = entryMatch[2];
          return !content?.entries?.[ei]?.[field]?.trim();
        }
      }
    }
    return false;
  });
}

function fieldLabel(path: string): string {
  const p = path.toLowerCase();
  if (p.includes("full_name")) return "Full Name";
  if (p.includes("email")) return "Email";
  if (p.includes("phone")) return "Phone Number";
  if (p.includes("location")) return "Location";
  if (p.includes("linkedin")) return "LinkedIn URL";
  if (p.includes("portfolio")) return "Portfolio URL";
  if (p.includes("github")) return "GitHub URL";
  if (p.includes("job_title")) return "Job Title";
  const secMatch = p.match(/sections?\[(\d+)\]/);
  if (secMatch) {
    const parts = path.split(".");
    return parts.slice(1).join(" → ").replace(/_/g, " ");
  }
  return path.replace(/_/g, " ").replace(/\b\w/g, (c) => c.toUpperCase());
}

export default function ResumeCompletionModal({
  resume: initialResume,
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onSaved,
}: ResumeCompletionModalProps) {
  const [resume, setResume] = useState<StructuredResume>(initialResume);
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);
  const [saveStatus, setSaveStatus] = useState<"idle" | "saving" | "saved">("idle");
  const debounceRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const sectionRefs = useRef<Record<string, HTMLElement | null>>({});

  const [isUploadingPhoto, setIsUploadingPhoto] = useState(false);
  const photoInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const handlePhotoUpload = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    setIsUploadingPhoto(true);
    try {
      const res = await uploadProfilePhoto(file);
      const updated = { ...resume, profile_photo_url: res.photo_url };
      setResume(updated);
      onSaved(updated);
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert("Failed to upload photo: " + (err.message || "Unknown error"));
    } finally {
      setIsUploadingPhoto(false);
    }
  };

  const handlePhotoDelete = async () => {
    if (!confirm("Are you sure you want to remove your profile photo?")) return;
    setIsUploadingPhoto(true);
    try {
      await deleteProfilePhoto();
      const updated = { ...resume, profile_photo_url: null };
      setResume(updated);
      onSaved(updated);
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert("Failed to remove photo: " + (err.message || "Unknown error"));
    } finally {
      setIsUploadingPhoto(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    setResume(initialResume);
  }, [initialResume]);

  const activeUnparsed = useMemo(() => getActiveUnparsedFields(resume), [resume]);
  const totalOriginal = resume.parse_confidence?.low_confidence_fields?.length ?? 0;
  const resolved = totalOriginal - activeUnparsed.length;
  const allResolved = activeUnparsed.length === 0;

  const handleContactChange = useCallback(
    (field: keyof ContactInfo, value: string) => {
      setResume((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        contact_info: { ...prev.contact_info, [field]: value },
      }));
      setSaveStatus("idle");
    },
    []
  );

  const handleSectionChange = useCallback((index: number, updated: any) => {
    setResume((prev) => {
      const sections = [...prev.sections];
      sections[index] = updated;
      return { ...prev, sections };
    });
  }, []);

  const handleSaveAndClose = async () => {
    try {
      setIsSaving(true);
      const updated = await updateStructuredResume(resume);
      setResume(updated);
      onSaved(updated);
      onClose();
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert("Failed to save: " + (err.message || "Unknown error"));
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const scrollToField = (fieldPath: string) => {
    const key = fieldPath.toLowerCase();

    // 1. Check for input by exact or cleaned ID
    const cleanId = fieldPath.replace(/\[/g, "_").replace(/\]/g, "").replace(/\./g, "_");
    const targetInput =
      document.getElementById(`input-${fieldPath}`) ||
      document.getElementById(`input-${cleanId}`) ||
      document.getElementById(fieldPath);

    if (targetInput) {
      targetInput.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "center" });
      targetInput.focus();
      targetInput.classList.add("ring-4", "ring-rose-500", "animate-pulse");
      setTimeout(() => {
        targetInput.classList.remove("ring-4", "ring-rose-500", "animate-pulse");
      }, 2000);
      return;
    }

    // 2. Section fallback
    if (
      key.includes("full_name") || key.includes("email") || key.includes("phone") ||
      key.includes("location") || key.includes("linkedin") || key.includes("portfolio") ||
      key.includes("github") || (key.includes("job_title") && key.includes("contact"))
    ) {
      const contactEl = sectionRefs.current["contact"];
      if (contactEl) {
        contactEl.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "center" });
        const input = contactEl.querySelector("input");
        if (input) {
          input.focus();
          input.classList.add("ring-4", "ring-rose-500", "animate-pulse");
          setTimeout(() => {
            input.classList.remove("ring-4", "ring-rose-500", "animate-pulse");
          }, 2000);
        }
      }
    } else {
      const secMatch = key.match(/sections?\[(\d+)\]/);
      if (secMatch) {
        const secEl = sectionRefs.current[`section-${secMatch[1]}`];
        if (secEl) {
          secEl.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "center" });
          const input = secEl.querySelector("input, textarea");
          if (input) {
            (input as HTMLElement).focus();
            input.classList.add("ring-4", "ring-rose-500", "animate-pulse");
            setTimeout(() => {
              input.classList.remove("ring-4", "ring-rose-500", "animate-pulse");
            }, 2000);
          }
        }
      }
    }
  };

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const ci = resume.contact_info;

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-950/70 backdrop-blur-md p-4 animate-in fade-in duration-200">
      <div className="w-full max-w-3xl max-h-[92vh] flex flex-col rounded-3xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 shadow-2xl overflow-hidden">

        {/* Modal Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-6 py-4 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50/80 dark:bg-slate-950/60 shrink-0">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-2xl bg-[#E6F7F4] dark:bg-slate-900/40 text-teal-600 dark:text-teal-400 flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm shrink-0">
              <Sparkles className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-2">
                Complete Master Resume Fields
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                {allResolved
                  ? "All fields 100% verified ✓"
                  : `${activeUnparsed.length} field${activeUnparsed.length !== 1 ? "s" : ""} need${activeUnparsed.length === 1 ? "s" : ""} your completion`}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <button
              onClick={onClose}
              className="p-2 rounded-xl text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            >
              <X className="w-5 h-5" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Unparsed Fields Alert Card (Bold Red Banner at VERY TOP) */}
        {activeUnparsed.length > 0 && (
          <div className="px-6 py-4 bg-rose-500 text-white dark:bg-rose-950/90 dark:text-rose-100 border-b border-rose-600 dark:border-rose-800 shrink-0 shadow-sm">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 mb-2 text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 text-white" />
                <span>Unparsed / Missing Fields ({activeUnparsed.length}) — Click chip to jump & edit:</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
              {activeUnparsed.map((field) => (
                <button
                  key={field}
                  onClick={() => scrollToField(field)}
                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-white text-rose-700 dark:bg-rose-900/90 dark:text-rose-100 border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-700 text-xs font-bold hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 transition-all shadow-sm cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <span>{fieldLabel(field)}</span>
                  <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-rose-500 dark:text-rose-300" />
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Resolution Progress Bar */}
        {totalOriginal > 0 && (
          <div className="px-6 py-2.5 bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-slate-900/50 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 shrink-0">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="flex-1 h-2 rounded-full bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 overflow-hidden">
                <div
                  className="h-full rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-500 via-purple-500 to-emerald-500 transition-all duration-500"
                  style={{ width: `${Math.round((resolved / totalOriginal) * 100)}%` }}
                />
              </div>
              <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 shrink-0">
                {resolved}/{totalOriginal} fields completed ({Math.round((resolved / totalOriginal) * 100)}%)
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Scrollable Body */}
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-6 py-5 space-y-6 bg-slate-50/30 dark:bg-slate-950/20">

          {/* Contact Details Card */}
          <div
            ref={(el) => { sectionRefs.current["contact"] = el; }}
            className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 shadow-sm overflow-hidden"
          >
            <div className="px-5 py-3.5 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50/80 dark:bg-slate-950/50">
              <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-2">
                <User className="w-4 h-4 text-teal-600 dark:text-teal-400" />
                Contact Information
              </h3>
            </div>

            {/* Profile Photo Uploader Box */}
            <div className="p-5 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-slate-950/30 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center gap-5">
              <div className="relative group shrink-0">
                {resume.profile_photo_url ? (
                  <img
                    src={getFullProfilePhotoUrl(resume.profile_photo_url) || ""}
                    alt="Profile Avatar"
                    className="w-20 h-20 rounded-2xl object-cover ring-4 ring-teal-500/20 shadow-md bg-white dark:bg-slate-800"
                  />
                ) : (
                  <div className="w-20 h-20 rounded-2xl bg-[#E6F7F4] dark:bg-slate-900/60 text-teal-600 dark:text-teal-400 border-2 border-dashed border-teal-300 dark:border-teal-700 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1 shadow-inner">
                    <User className="w-8 h-8 opacity-80" />
                    <span className="text-[9px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">No Photo</span>
                  </div>
                )}
                {isUploadingPhoto && (
                  <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-slate-950/60 backdrop-blur-xs rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center text-white">
                    <Loader2 className="w-6 h-6 animate-spin" />
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-1.5 text-center sm:text-left flex-1">
                <h4 className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white flex items-center justify-center sm:justify-start gap-2">
                  Candidate Profile Photo
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-extrabold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/20">
                    Executive Profile Compatible
                  </span>
                </h4>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 leading-relaxed">
                  Uploaded photos display cleanly on your UI workspace cards & automatically render in Executive Profile DOCX/PDF downloads.
                </p>

                <div className="flex items-center justify-center sm:justify-start gap-2 pt-1">
                  <input
                    ref={photoInputRef}
                    type="file"
                    accept="image/png,image/jpeg,image/webp,image/jpg"
                    onChange={handlePhotoUpload}
                    className="hidden"
                  />
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    disabled={isUploadingPhoto}
                    onClick={() => photoInputRef.current?.click()}
                    className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-teal-600 hover:bg-teal-500 text-white font-extrabold text-xs shadow-md shadow-teal-500/20 hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <Camera className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    {resume.profile_photo_url ? "Change Photo" : "Upload Photo"}
                  </button>

                  {resume.profile_photo_url && (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      disabled={isUploadingPhoto}
                      onClick={handlePhotoDelete}
                      className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/60 hover:bg-rose-100 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300 font-bold text-xs border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-800 hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      Remove
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="p-5 grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              {[
                { key: "full_name" as const, label: "Full Name", icon: User, placeholder: "e.g. Ahmad Barajaib" },
                { key: "job_title" as const, label: "Job Title / Headline", icon: Briefcase, placeholder: "e.g. Senior Software Engineer" },
                { key: "email" as const, label: "Email Address", icon: Mail, placeholder: "e.g. ahmad@example.com" },
                { key: "phone" as const, label: "Phone Number", icon: Phone, placeholder: "e.g. +971 50 123 4567" },
                { key: "location" as const, label: "City, Country", icon: MapPin, placeholder: "e.g. Dubai, UAE" },
                { key: "linkedin_url" as const, label: "LinkedIn URL", icon: Link, placeholder: "linkedin.com/in/..." },
                { key: "portfolio_url" as const, label: "Portfolio / Website", icon: Globe, placeholder: "yoursite.com" },
                { key: "github_url" as const, label: "GitHub URL", icon: GitBranch, placeholder: "github.com/username" },
              ].map(({ key, label, icon: Icon, placeholder }) => {
                const val = (ci as any)[key] ?? "";
                const isUnparsed = activeUnparsed.some((f) => f.toLowerCase().includes(key.replace("_url", "").replace("_", "_")));
                return (
                  <div key={key}>
                    <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1.5">
                      {label}
                    </label>
                    <div className="relative">
                      <Icon className="absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500" />
                      <input
                        id={`input-contact_info.${key}`}
                        type="text"
                        value={val}
                        onChange={(e) => handleContactChange(key, e.target.value)}
                        placeholder={placeholder}
                        className={`w-full pl-10 pr-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-sm font-medium transition-all outline-none text-slate-900 dark:text-white placeholder-slate-400 dark:placeholder-slate-500
                          ${isUnparsed
                            ? "bg-rose-50/90 dark:bg-rose-950/40 border-2 border-rose-500 dark:border-rose-600 text-rose-950 dark:text-rose-100 focus:border-rose-600 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-rose-500/30"
                            : "bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/80 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 focus:bg-white focus:border-teal-600 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-teal-500/20"
                          }`}
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Section Editors */}
          {resume.sections.map((section, index) => (
            <div
              key={`${section.section_type}-${index}`}
              id={`input-section-${index}`}
              ref={(el) => { sectionRefs.current[`section-${index}`] = el; }}
            >
              <ResumeSectionEditor
                section={section}
                index={index}
                lowConfidenceFields={resume.parse_confidence?.low_confidence_fields ?? []}
                onChange={(updated) => handleSectionChange(index, updated)}
                onDelete={() => {
                  setResume((prev) => ({
                    ...prev,
                    sections: prev.sections.filter((_, i) => i !== index),
                  }));
                }}
              />
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* Footer Actions */}
        <div className="px-6 py-4 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50/80 dark:bg-slate-950/60 shrink-0 flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <div className="text-xs font-semibold">
            {allResolved ? (
              <span className="text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" />
                Master resume is 100% complete & verified
              </span>
            ) : (
              <span className="text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">
                {activeUnparsed.length} field{activeUnparsed.length !== 1 ? "s" : ""} remaining to complete
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <button
              onClick={onClose}
              className="px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-200/60 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            >
              Close
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={handleSaveAndClose}
              disabled={isSaving}
              className="px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold bg-teal-600 hover:bg-teal-500 text-white transition-all shadow-md shadow-teal-500/20 flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-60"
            >
              {isSaving ? <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" /> : <Save className="w-4 h-4" />}
              {isSaving ? "Saving..." : allResolved ? "Save Master Resume" : `Save & Close (${activeUnparsed.length} remaining)`}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
````

## File: frontend/src/components/resume_section_editor.tsx
````typescript
"use client";

import React, { useState } from "react";
import {
  ChevronDown,
  ChevronUp,
  Trash2,
  Eye,
  EyeOff,
  Plus,
  AlertTriangle,
  GripVertical,
  Briefcase,
  GraduationCap,
  Award,
  FolderGit2,
  Code,
  FileText,
  Layers,
  Zap,
  Lock,
} from "lucide-react";
import { ResumeSection } from "@/lib/structured_resume_api";

interface ResumeSectionEditorProps {
  section: ResumeSection;
  index: number;
  lowConfidenceFields: string[];
  onChange: (updatedSection: ResumeSection) => void;
  onDelete: () => void;
  onMoveUp?: () => void;
  onMoveDown?: () => void;
}

export default function ResumeSectionEditor({
  section,
  index,
  lowConfidenceFields,
  onChange,
  onDelete,
  onMoveUp,
  onMoveDown,
}: ResumeSectionEditorProps) {
  const [isExpanded, setIsExpanded] = useState(true);

  const isLowConf = (fieldPath: string) => {
    return lowConfidenceFields.some(
      (path) => path.startsWith(fieldPath) || path === fieldPath
    );
  };

  const getSectionIcon = (type: string) => {
    switch (type) {
      case "summary":
        return <FileText className="h-4 w-4 text-teal-500" />;
      case "skills":
        return <Code className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-500" />;
      case "experience":
        return <Briefcase className="h-4 w-4 text-teal-500" />;
      case "education":
        return <GraduationCap className="h-4 w-4 text-purple-500" />;
      case "projects":
        return <FolderGit2 className="h-4 w-4 text-amber-500" />;
      case "certifications":
        return <Award className="h-4 w-4 text-rose-500" />;
      default:
        return <Layers className="h-4 w-4 text-slate-500" />;
    }
  };

  const updateContent = (newContent: Record<string, any>) => {
    onChange({
      ...section,
      content: newContent,
    });
  };

  return (
    <div
      className={`rounded-2xl border transition-all shadow-sm ${
        section.visible
          ? "bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800"
          : "bg-slate-50/60 dark:bg-slate-900/40 border-slate-200/60 dark:border-slate-800/60 opacity-75"
      }`}
    >
      {/* Card Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-3 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/80 bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-slate-900/50 rounded-t-2xl">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 flex-1 min-w-0">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-slate-400">
            {onMoveUp && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={onMoveUp}
                className="p-1 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-white transition-all cursor-pointer"
                title="Move section up"
              >
                <ChevronUp className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              </button>
            )}
            {onMoveDown && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={onMoveDown}
                className="p-1 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-white transition-all cursor-pointer"
                title="Move section down"
              >
                <ChevronDown className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              </button>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="p-1.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800">
            {getSectionIcon(section.section_type)}
          </div>

          <input
            type="text"
            value={section.section_title}
            onChange={(e) => onChange({ ...section, section_title: e.target.value })}
            className="font-bold text-sm text-slate-900 dark:text-white bg-transparent border-b border-transparent hover:border-slate-300 dark:hover:border-slate-700 focus:border-teal-500 focus:outline-none px-1 py-0.5 transition-all flex-1 min-w-0"
            placeholder="Section Title"
          />

          {isLowConf(`sections.${index}`) && (
            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-bold text-rose-500 bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/50 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-800">
              <AlertTriangle className="h-3 w-3 shrink-0" /> Review Required
            </span>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 ml-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => onChange({ ...section, visible: !section.visible })}
            className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1 border select-none ${
              section.visible
                ? "bg-teal-500/10 text-teal-700 dark:text-teal-300 border-teal-500/30 hover:bg-teal-500/20"
                : "bg-slate-100 text-slate-500 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-400 border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700"
            }`}
            title={section.visible ? "AI Tailoring ENABLED for this section. Click to Lock/Disable." : "AI Tailoring DISABLED for this section. Click to Enable."}
          >
            {section.visible ? (
              <>
                <Zap className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-amber-500 fill-amber-500 shrink-0" />
                <span>AI Tailor ON</span>
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <Lock className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-slate-400 shrink-0" />
                <span>AI Tailor OFF</span>
              </>
            )}
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onDelete}
            className="p-1.5 rounded-xl text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-50 dark:hover:bg-rose-950/40 transition-all cursor-pointer"
            title="Delete section"
          >
            <Trash2 className="h-4 w-4" />
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setIsExpanded(!isExpanded)}
            className="p-1.5 rounded-xl text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-all cursor-pointer"
          >
            {isExpanded ? <ChevronUp className="h-4 w-4" /> : <ChevronDown className="h-4 w-4" />}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Card Content Body */}
      {isExpanded && (
        <div className="p-4 space-y-4 text-xs">
          {/* 1. Summary Section */}
          {section.section_type === "summary" && (
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <label className="font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                Professional Summary Text
              </label>
              <textarea
                value={section.content?.text || section.content?.summary || ""}
                onChange={(e) => updateContent({ ...section.content, text: e.target.value })}
                rows={4}
                className="w-full p-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-slate-900/50 text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-teal-500 focus:outline-none transition-all leading-relaxed"
                placeholder="Write your professional summary..."
              />
            </div>
          )}

          {/* 2. Skills Section */}
          {section.section_type === "skills" && (
            <SkillsEditor
              categories={section.content?.categories || []}
              onChange={(newCategories) => updateContent({ ...section.content, categories: newCategories })}
            />
          )}

          {/* 3. Experience Section */}
          {section.section_type === "experience" && (
            <ExperienceEditor
              entries={section.content?.entries || []}
              sectionIndex={index}
              lowConfidenceFields={lowConfidenceFields}
              onChange={(newEntries) => updateContent({ ...section.content, entries: newEntries })}
            />
          )}

          {/* 4. Education Section */}
          {section.section_type === "education" && (
            <EducationEditor
              entries={section.content?.entries || []}
              sectionIndex={index}
              lowConfidenceFields={lowConfidenceFields}
              onChange={(newEntries) => updateContent({ ...section.content, entries: newEntries })}
            />
          )}

          {/* 5. Projects Section */}
          {section.section_type === "projects" && (
            <ProjectsEditor
              entries={section.content?.entries || []}
              sectionIndex={index}
              lowConfidenceFields={lowConfidenceFields}
              onChange={(newEntries) => updateContent({ ...section.content, entries: newEntries })}
            />
          )}

          {/* 6. Certifications Section */}
          {section.section_type === "certifications" && (
            <CertificationsEditor
              entries={section.content?.entries || []}
              sectionIndex={index}
              lowConfidenceFields={lowConfidenceFields}
              onChange={(newEntries) => updateContent({ ...section.content, entries: newEntries })}
            />
          )}

          {/* 7. Custom or Fallback List Section */}
          {section.section_type === "custom" && (
            <CustomListEditor
              entries={section.content?.entries || []}
              sectionIndex={index}
              onChange={(newEntries) => updateContent({ ...section.content, entries: newEntries })}
            />
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Skills Editor ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function SkillsEditor({
  categories,
  onChange,
}: {
  categories: any[];
  onChange: (cats: any[]) => void;
}) {
  const addCategory = () => {
    onChange([...categories, { category_name: "New Skill Category", skills: ["Skill 1"] }]);
  };

  const updateCategory = (idx: number, cat: any) => {
    const updated = [...categories];
    updated[idx] = cat;
    onChange(updated);
  };

  const removeCategory = (idx: number) => {
    onChange(categories.filter((_, i) => i !== idx));
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      {categories.map((cat, idx) => (
        <div
          key={idx}
          className="p-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-slate-900/50 space-y-2"
        >
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <input
              type="text"
              value={cat.category_name || ""}
              onChange={(e) => updateCategory(idx, { ...cat, category_name: e.target.value })}
              className="font-bold text-xs text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 bg-transparent border-b border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 focus:border-teal-500 focus:outline-none px-1"
              placeholder="Category Name (e.g. Languages)"
            />
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => removeCategory(idx)}
              className="text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-500 p-1 cursor-pointer"
            >
              <Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            </button>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
            {(cat.skills || []).map((skill: string, sIdx: number) => (
              <span
                key={sIdx}
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 text-xs font-medium text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 shadow-sm"
              >
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={skill}
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    const newSkills = [...cat.skills];
                    newSkills[sIdx] = e.target.value;
                    updateCategory(idx, { ...cat, skills: newSkills });
                  }}
                  className="bg-transparent focus:outline-none w-24"
                />
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    const newSkills = cat.skills.filter((_: any, i: number) => i !== sIdx);
                    updateCategory(idx, { ...cat, skills: newSkills });
                  }}
                  className="text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-500 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  ×
                </button>
              </span>
            ))}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => updateCategory(idx, { ...cat, skills: [...(cat.skills || []), "New Skill"] })}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg bg-teal-50 dark:bg-slate-900/50 border border-teal-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-teal-600 dark:text-teal-400 text-xs font-semibold hover:bg-[#E6F7F4] transition-all cursor-pointer"
            >
              <Plus className="h-3 w-3" /> Add Skill
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      ))}

      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={addCategory}
        className="w-full py-2 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 rounded-xl font-semibold text-xs transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center gap-1"
      >
        <Plus className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Add Skill Category
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Experience Editor ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function ExperienceEditor({
  entries,
  sectionIndex,
  lowConfidenceFields,
  onChange,
}: {
  entries: any[];
  sectionIndex: number;
  lowConfidenceFields: string[];
  onChange: (entries: any[]) => void;
}) {
  const addEntry = () => {
    onChange([
      ...entries,
      {
        job_title: "Senior Role",
        company: "Company Name",
        location: "City, Country",
        start_date: "Jan 2023",
        end_date: "Present",
        bullets: ["Achieved major milestone improving efficiency by 30%."],
      },
    ]);
  };

  const updateEntry = (idx: number, entry: any) => {
    const updated = [...entries];
    updated[idx] = entry;
    onChange(updated);
  };

  const removeEntry = (idx: number) => {
    onChange(entries.filter((_, i) => i !== idx));
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {entries.map((item, idx) => {
        const e = typeof item === "string" ? { job_title: item, company: "", location: "", start_date: "", end_date: "", bullets: [] } : item;
        const titlePath = `sections.${sectionIndex}.content.entries.${idx}.job_title`;
        const companyPath = `sections.${sectionIndex}.content.entries.${idx}.company`;
        const isTitleLow = lowConfidenceFields.includes(titlePath);
        const isCompanyLow = lowConfidenceFields.includes(companyPath);

        return (
          <div
            key={idx}
            className="p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-slate-900/50 space-y-3"
          >
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
              <span className="font-bold text-xs text-teal-600 dark:text-teal-400 uppercase tracking-wider">
                Experience #{idx + 1}
              </span>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => removeEntry(idx)}
                className="text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-500 p-1 cursor-pointer"
              >
                <Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2">
              <div>
                <label className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 flex items-center justify-between">
                  Job Title
                  {isTitleLow && (
                    <span className="text-rose-500 font-bold text-[10px] flex items-center gap-0.5">
                      <AlertTriangle className="h-3 w-3" /> Verify Title
                    </span>
                  )}
                </label>
                <input
                  id={`field-sections-${sectionIndex}-content-entries-${idx}-job_title`}
                  data-field={titlePath}
                  type="text"
                  value={e.job_title || ""}
                  onChange={(evt) => updateEntry(idx, { ...e, job_title: evt.target.value })}
                  className={`w-full p-2 rounded-lg border text-xs bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none ${
                    isTitleLow
                      ? "border-rose-400 dark:border-rose-500 bg-rose-50/20"
                      : "border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700"
                  }`}
                  placeholder="e.g. Senior Full Stack Developer"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 flex items-center justify-between">
                  Company
                  {isCompanyLow && (
                    <span className="text-rose-500 font-bold text-[10px] flex items-center gap-0.5">
                      <AlertTriangle className="h-3 w-3" /> Verify Company
                    </span>
                  )}
                </label>
                <input
                  id={`field-sections-${sectionIndex}-content-entries-${idx}-company`}
                  data-field={companyPath}
                  type="text"
                  value={e.company || ""}
                  onChange={(evt) => updateEntry(idx, { ...e, company: evt.target.value })}
                  className={`w-full p-2 rounded-lg border text-xs bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none ${
                    isCompanyLow
                      ? "border-rose-400 dark:border-rose-500 bg-rose-50/20"
                      : "border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700"
                  }`}
                  placeholder="e.g. Tech Corp Inc"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                  Location
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={e.location || ""}
                  onChange={(evt) => updateEntry(idx, { ...e, location: evt.target.value })}
                  className="w-full p-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none"
                  placeholder="e.g. San Francisco, CA"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <div className="flex-1">
                  <label className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                    Start Date
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={e.start_date || ""}
                    onChange={(evt) => updateEntry(idx, { ...e, start_date: evt.target.value })}
                    className="w-full p-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none"
                    placeholder="e.g. Jan 2021"
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="flex-1">
                  <label className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                    End Date
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={e.end_date || ""}
                    onChange={(evt) => updateEntry(idx, { ...e, end_date: evt.target.value })}
                    className="w-full p-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none"
                    placeholder="e.g. Present"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Bullet Points */}
            <div className="space-y-1.5 pt-1">
              <label className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">Key Achievements / Bullets</label>
              {(e.bullets || []).map((bullet: string, bIdx: number) => (
                <div key={bIdx} className="flex items-start gap-2">
                  <textarea
                    value={bullet}
                    onChange={(evt) => {
                      const newBullets = [...(e.bullets || [])];
                      newBullets[bIdx] = evt.target.value;
                      updateEntry(idx, { ...e, bullets: newBullets });
                    }}
                    rows={2}
                    className="flex-1 p-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none"
                  />
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      const newBullets = (e.bullets || []).filter((_: any, i: number) => i !== bIdx);
                      updateEntry(idx, { ...e, bullets: newBullets });
                    }}
                    className="text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-500 p-1 cursor-pointer pt-1"
                  >
                    ×
                  </button>
                </div>
              ))}
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => updateEntry(idx, { ...e, bullets: [...(e.bullets || []), "New achievement bullet point."] })}
                className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-teal-600 dark:text-teal-400 hover:underline flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer pt-1"
              >
                <Plus className="h-3 w-3" /> Add Bullet Point
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        );
      })}

      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={addEntry}
        className="w-full py-2 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 rounded-xl font-semibold text-xs transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center gap-1"
      >
        <Plus className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Add Experience Entry
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Education Editor ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function EducationEditor({
  entries,
  sectionIndex,
  lowConfidenceFields,
  onChange,
}: {
  entries: any[];
  sectionIndex?: number;
  lowConfidenceFields?: string[];
  onChange: (e: any[]) => void;
}) {
  const addEntry = () => {
    onChange([
      ...entries,
      { degree: "Bachelor of Technology", institution: "University Name", location: "City", graduation_date: "2022" },
    ]);
  };

  const updateEntry = (idx: number, entry: any) => {
    const updated = [...entries];
    updated[idx] = entry;
    onChange(updated);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      {entries.map((item, idx) => {
        const e = typeof item === "string" ? { degree: item, institution: "", location: "", graduation_date: "" } : item;
        const degreePath = `education.${idx}.degree`;
        const instPath = `education.${idx}.institution`;
        const locPath = `education.${idx}.location`;
        const gradPath = `education.${idx}.graduation_date`;

        const isLocLow = lowConfidenceFields?.some((p) => p.includes(`education.${idx}.location`) || p.includes(`entries.${idx}.location`));
        const isGradLow = lowConfidenceFields?.some((p) => p.includes(`education.${idx}.graduation_date`) || p.includes(`entries.${idx}.graduation_date`));

        return (
          <div key={idx} className="p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-slate-900/50 space-y-2">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="font-bold text-xs text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400">Education #{idx + 1}</span>
              <button type="button" onClick={() => onChange(entries.filter((_, i) => i !== idx))} className="text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-500 p-1 cursor-pointer">
                <Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              </button>
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2">
              <div>
                <label className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-slate-400 block mb-1">Degree / Qualification</label>
                <input
                  id={`field-education-${idx}-degree`}
                  data-field={degreePath}
                  type="text"
                  value={e.degree || ""}
                  onChange={(evt) => updateEntry(idx, { ...e, degree: evt.target.value })}
                  className="w-full p-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-white"
                  placeholder="Degree / Qualification"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-slate-400 block mb-1">Institution / University</label>
                <input
                  id={`field-education-${idx}-institution`}
                  data-field={instPath}
                  type="text"
                  value={e.institution || ""}
                  onChange={(evt) => updateEntry(idx, { ...e, institution: evt.target.value })}
                  className="w-full p-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-white"
                  placeholder="Institution / University"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-slate-400 flex items-center justify-between mb-1">
                  Location
                  {isLocLow && <span className="text-rose-500 font-bold text-[9px]">⚠️ Verify</span>}
                </label>
                <input
                  id={`field-education-${idx}-location`}
                  data-field={locPath}
                  type="text"
                  value={e.location || ""}
                  onChange={(evt) => updateEntry(idx, { ...e, location: evt.target.value })}
                  className={`w-full p-2 rounded-lg border text-xs bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-900 dark:text-white ${
                    isLocLow ? "border-rose-400 dark:border-rose-500 bg-rose-50/20" : "border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700"
                  }`}
                  placeholder="Location"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-slate-400 flex items-center justify-between mb-1">
                  Graduation Year / Date
                  {isGradLow && <span className="text-rose-500 font-bold text-[9px]">⚠️ Verify</span>}
                </label>
                <input
                  id={`field-education-${idx}-graduation_date`}
                  data-field={gradPath}
                  type="text"
                  value={e.graduation_date || ""}
                  onChange={(evt) => updateEntry(idx, { ...e, graduation_date: evt.target.value })}
                  className={`w-full p-2 rounded-lg border text-xs bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-900 dark:text-white ${
                    isGradLow ? "border-rose-400 dark:border-rose-500 bg-rose-50/20" : "border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700"
                  }`}
                  placeholder="Graduation Year / Date"
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        );
      })}
      <button type="button" onClick={addEntry} className="w-full py-2 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-200 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center gap-1">
        <Plus className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Add Education
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

function ProjectsEditor({

                <Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />

            </div>

                  />
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      const newBullets = (e.bullets || []).filter((_: any, i: number) => i !== bIdx);
                      updateEntry(idx, { ...e, bullets: newBullets });
                    }}
                    className="text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-500 p-1 cursor-pointer pt-1"
                  >
                    ×
                  </button>
                </div>
              ))}
              <button
                type="button"

      >
        <Plus className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Add Project

// ── Custom List Editor ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function CustomListEditor({
  entries,
  sectionIndex,
  onChange,
}: {
  entries: any[];
  sectionIndex?: number;
  onChange: (e: any[]) => void;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-2.5">
      {entries.map((entry, idx) => (
        <div key={idx} className="flex items-start gap-2 group">
          <span className="text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-bold text-xs pt-2 select-none">•</span>
          <textarea
            value={typeof entry === "string" ? entry : entry.text || ""}
            onChange={(e) => {
              const updated = [...entries];
              updated[idx] = e.target.value;
              onChange(updated);
            }}
            rows={2}
            placeholder="Enter custom section detail, bullet point, or item..."
            className="flex-1 p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:border-teal-500 focus:outline-none shadow-sm transition-all"
          />
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => onChange(entries.filter((_, i) => i !== idx))}
            className="text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-500 p-1.5 cursor-pointer pt-2 transition-colors"
          >
            <Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
          </button>
        </div>
      ))}
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => onChange([...entries, "New item entry."])}
        className="w-full py-2 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 rounded-xl font-semibold text-xs transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm"
      >
        <Plus className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-teal-500" /> Add Custom Entry Item
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````typescript
}

  {
    id: "clean_classic",
    title: "Clean Classic",
    subtitle: "Minimalist academic & corporate standard. Maximum ATS pass rate.",

    badge: "100% ATS Safe",

    colorScheme: "border-slate-300 bg-white",
  },
  {

  },
];

interface TemplateSelectorProps {
  selectedTemplate: string;
  onSelectTemplate: (templateId: "clean_classic" | "modern_professional" | "executive_profile") => void;

}

export default function TemplateSelector({
  selectedTemplate,
  onSelectTemplate,
  sourceFormat,

  return (

      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">

        </h3>
        {sourceFormat === "docx" && (
          <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-emerald-700 bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full flex items-center gap-1">
            <Sparkles className="h-3 w-3 text-emerald-500" /> Auto-Matched from Upload
          </span>
        )}
        {sourceFormat === "pdf" && (
          <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-amber-700 bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full">
            PDF Uploaded — Choose ATS Template
          </span>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
        {TEMPLATES.map((tmpl) => {
          const isSelected = selectedTemplate === tmpl.id;
          return (
            <button
              key={tmpl.id}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onSelectTemplate(tmpl.id)}
              className={`relative text-left p-3.5 rounded-2xl border transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-sm flex flex-col justify-between ${
                isSelected
                  ? "border-teal-600 ring-2 ring-teal-500/20 bg-teal-50/50"
                  : "border-slate-200 hover:border-teal-300 bg-white"
              }`}
            >
              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-1 mb-1">
                  <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-1">
                    {tmpl.title}
                  </span>
                  {isSelected && (
                    <span className="h-4 w-4 rounded-full bg-teal-600 text-white flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                      <Check className="h-2.5 w-2.5" />
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 leading-tight mb-2">
                  {tmpl.subtitle}
                </p>
              </div>

              <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] font-medium text-slate-400">
                <span>Font: {tmpl.font}</span>
                <span
                  className={`px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md font-bold text-[9px] ${
                    tmpl.hasPhotoSupport
                      ? "bg-[#E6F7F4] text-teal-700"
                      : "bg-slate-100 text-slate-600"
                  }`}
                >
                  {tmpl.badge}
                </span>
              </div>
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````markdown
# Deployment Guide: VPS & Vercel Hosting

This guide details how to host the **Role Craft** application in production:
* **Frontend**: Hosted serverless on **Vercel** pointing to `https://rolecraft.tech`.
* **Backend**: Dockerized and hosted on your **VPS** pointing to `https://api.rolecraft.tech` behind a host-level **Nginx** reverse proxy.
* **CI/CD**: Fully automated deploys for Vercel and VPS on git pushes to `main`.

---

## 1. VPS Host Setup (Nginx + Docker)

Log in to your VPS and install the required tools:

```bash
# Update packages
sudo apt update && sudo apt upgrade -y

# Install Docker & Docker Compose
sudo apt install docker.io docker-compose-v2 -y
sudo systemctl enable docker --now

# Install Nginx & Certbot for SSL
sudo apt install nginx certbot python3-certbot-nginx -y
```

---

## 2. Deploying the Backend API

1. **Clone the Repository**:
   ```bash
   cd /opt
   git clone https://github.com/your-username/rolecraft.git
    # If you already created /opt/role_craft, you can clone directly into it:
    # git clone https://github.com/your-username/rolecraft.git /opt/role_craft
   ```

2. **Configure Environment Variables**:
   Create a `.env` file in the root directory:
   ```bash
   nano .env
   ```
   Add the following variables:
   ```env
   OPENAI_API_KEY="your-openai-api-key"
   GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID="your-google-developer-client-id"
   JWT_SECRET="generate-a-secure-random-phrase-here"
   ```

3. **Launch the Container**:
   Build and start the container in detached background mode:
   ```bash
   docker compose up -d --build
   ```
   The SQLite database will be persistently stored at `./data/rolecraft.db` on your host machine.

---

## 3. Host Nginx Reverse Proxy Config

1. Create a server configuration for your API subdomain:
   ```bash
   sudo nano /etc/nginx/sites-available/api.rolecraft.tech
   ```

2. Paste the following configuration:
   ```nginx
   server {
       listen 80;
       server_name api.rolecraft.tech;

       location / {
           proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:8000;
           proxy_http_version 1.1;
           proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;
           proxy_set_header Connection 'upgrade';
           proxy_set_header Host $host;
           proxy_cache_bypass $http_upgrade;
           proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
           proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
           proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
       }
   }
   ```

3. Enable the config and restart Nginx:
   ```bash
   sudo ln -s /etc/nginx/sites-available/api.rolecraft.tech /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/
   sudo nginx -t
   sudo systemctl restart nginx
   ```

4. Secure the domain with a free Let's Encrypt SSL certificate:
   ```bash
   sudo certbot --nginx -d api.rolecraft.tech
   ```

---

## 4. Deploying the Frontend on Vercel

1. Log in to your [Vercel Dashboard](https://vercel.com) and click **Add New Project**.
2. Connect your GitHub repository and select the **`frontend`** directory as the root folder.
3. Configure the **Environment Variables** in the Vercel panel:
   * `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL` = `https://api.rolecraft.tech`
   * `NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID` = `your-google-developer-client-id`
4. Click **Deploy**. Vercel will automatically build and deploy the frontend on every git push to the `main` branch.
5. In your Vercel project settings, navigate to **Domains** and add your custom domain `rolecraft.tech`.

---

## 5. Setting up CI/CD to VPS (Secure Webhook Redeployment)

To bypass standard SSH rate-limiting blocks and connection timeouts on public cloud subnets (like GitHub Actions runners), we use a secure local webhook deployment listener on the VPS host.

### How it works:
1. A lightweight Python webhook script listens locally on port `9000` (`/opt/role_craft/deploy_webhook.py`).
2. Nginx maps secure incoming requests at `https://api.rolecraft.tech/deploy-webhook` to the local port `9000`.
3. The script is registered as a persistent systemd service `rolecraft-deploy.service` on the host.
4. When a push to `main` occurs, the GitHub Action (`.github/workflows/deploy.yml`) calls the HTTPS endpoint securely using `curl` with a custom token header (`X-Deploy-Token`), triggering an in-background build.

### Steps to configure:
1. Create the deploy script on the VPS host at `/opt/role_craft/deploy_webhook.py`.
2. Register and start the systemd unit `/etc/systemd/system/rolecraft-deploy.service`:
   ```bash
   systemctl daemon-reload
   systemctl enable rolecraft-deploy --now
   ```
3. Update the Nginx proxy site configuration on the VPS to include:
   ```nginx
   location /deploy-webhook {
       proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:9000;
       proxy_set_header Host $host;
       proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
       proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
       proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
   }
   ```
4. Reload Nginx (`systemctl reload nginx`).
5. (Optional) Set `DEPLOY_TOKEN` as an Action secret on GitHub to override the default token.

---

## 6. Admin Dashboard Subdomain (`admin.rolecraft.tech`) Setup

The admin control panel is hosted completely isolated from normal users at `admin.rolecraft.tech`.

### 1. DNS Record
In your domain registrar / DNS manager for `rolecraft.tech`:
- Add an **`A` record**:
  - Host / Name: `admin`
  - Value: Your VPS IP address (same IP as `rolecraft.tech`)
  - TTL: Auto / 300

### 2. Environment Variable
Generate a strong secret key:
```bash
openssl rand -hex 16
```
Add to `backend/.env`:
```env
ADMIN_SECRET="your-generated-16-character-secret"
```

### 3. Web Server Reverse Proxy

**Option A: Caddy (`/etc/caddy/Caddyfile`)**
```caddy
admin.rolecraft.tech {
    header X-Robots-Tag "noindex, nofollow"
    rewrite * /xrc-control{uri}
    reverse_proxy localhost:3000
}
```
Reload Caddy: `systemctl reload caddy`

**Option B: Nginx (`/etc/nginx/sites-available/admin.rolecraft.tech`)**
```nginx
server {
    listen 80;
    server_name admin.rolecraft.tech;
    add_header X-Robots-Tag "noindex, nofollow" always;

    location / {
        rewrite ^(.*)$ /xrc-control$1 break;
        proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:3000;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
    }
}
```
Enable and secure with Certbot:
```bash
sudo ln -s /etc/nginx/sites-available/admin.rolecraft.tech /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/
sudo certbot --nginx -d admin.rolecraft.tech
sudo systemctl reload nginx
```

### 4. One-Time Superuser Bootstrap
Promote your account (`ahbarajaib@gmail.com`) to Administrator:
```bash
cd backend
source .venv/bin/activate
python scripts/bootstrap_admin.py
```

When applying backend changes to the running production container without rebuilding from scratch:

docker restart rolecraft-backend
```

To view live container logs:
```bash

```
````

````markdown
# RoleCraft

### Craft every resume for the role you’re applying to.

AI-powered resume optimization platform. Upload a DOCX resume, provide a job description, and receive a 1-click tailored resume that preserves 100% of your original formatting and fonts.
````
