````markdown
## Project Status

> **Milestone 21 – Dual Billing Modes (One-Off 30-Day Pass + Subscriptions), Immediate Checkout Verification, User Deletion & Container Extension Distribution (Complete)**
> * **Dual Billing Modes**: Users can now choose between a **One-Time 30-Day Pass** (zero recurring auto-debit, 100% UPI/card compatibility) and an **Auto-Renewing Monthly Subscription** via Razorpay. Automatic pass expiration is gracefully enforced via `plan_expires_at`.
> * **Immediate Checkout Verification (`POST /api/v1/payment/verify`)**: Checkout activates membership and full tier credits in milliseconds directly on payment completion, without waiting for webhook latencies.
> * **Admin User Deletion (`POST /api/v1/admin/users/{id}/delete`)**: Admins can permanently delete user accounts with full cascade purge of analyses, master resumes, and tailored resumes, plus self-deletion protection.
> * **Auto-Grant Credits on Upgrade**: Admin plan upgrades to Pro or Elite automatically top up user credits to the tier quota (200 / 400 credits).
> * **Container-Bundled Chrome Extension**: Chrome extension files are bundled directly inside `backend/app/extension_src/` for 100% reliable streaming downloads inside Docker containers.

> **Milestone 20 – Admin Dashboard & Platform Control Center (Complete)**
> A dedicated, undiscoverable administrative portal (`admin.rolecraft.tech` / `/xrc-control/`) with two-layer authentication (JWT + Secret PIN) is now live. Features include real-time financial metrics and estimated MRR, interactive 30-day signup and feature usage analytics, comprehensive user management with credit top-up drawers, user deletion, plan changers, centralized support ticket triage with technical JSON context, dynamic live system configuration editing (`SiteConfig`), and an immutable audit trail (`AdminActivityLog`).

> **Milestone 19 – LinkedIn Job Copier Chrome Extension, Premium Gated Distribution & Mobile Bottom Nav (Complete)**
> RoleCraft now ships a branded **LinkedIn Job Copier Chrome Extension** (Manifest V3), distributed securely via the backend API (`GET /api/v1/extension/download`) and gated to **Pro & Elite** subscribers. The `ExtensionModal` component guides users through installation. A new **Mobile Bottom Navigation Bar** (`mobile_bottom_nav.tsx`) replaces the hamburger menu on small screens for improved one-thumb ergonomics. The extension extracts job title, company, location, and full description from any LinkedIn job page in one click, with a multi-strategy DOM fallback system (6/5/4/5 strategies per field) resilient to LinkedIn DOM changes.

## Getting Started

### Prerequisites

| Tool | Version |
|------|---------|

| [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) | latest |

### 1 – Clone and enter the repository

```bash
git clone <repo-url>
cd RoleCraft
```

### 2 – Create the virtual environment and install dependencies

```bash
uv venv
source .venv/bin/activate   # macOS / Linux
# .venv\Scripts\activate    # Windows
```

```bash
cd backend
uv sync
```

### 3 – Configure the environment

```bash
cp .env.example .env
# Edit .env as needed (defaults work for local development)
```

### 4 – Run the development server

```bash
# From the backend/ directory:
uvicorn main:app --reload

# Or using the built-in helper:
python main.py
```

The API will be available at **http://localhost:8000**.

## Key Endpoints

| Method | Path | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `GET` | `/api/v1/health` | Liveness probe |
| `POST` | `/api/v1/documents/upload` | Upload a DOCX or PDF resume |
| `POST` | `/api/v1/documents/set-base` | Set document as workspace base resume |
| `POST` | `/api/v1/structured-resume/parse` | Parse DOCX/PDF resume into Master Resume JSON |
| `GET` | `/api/v1/structured-resume` | Fetch active user's Master Resume JSON |
| `PUT` | `/api/v1/structured-resume` | Update Master Resume JSON section entries |
| `GET` | `/api/v1/structured-resume/generate/{template}/{format}` | Generate & stream ATS DOCX or PDF export |
| `POST` | `/api/v1/resume/analyze` | Full resume vs JD gap analysis workflow (JSON-first) |
| `POST` | `/api/v1/resume/rewrite` | AI review & rewrite single resume section |
| `POST` | `/api/v1/resume/apply` | Merge approved section rewrites & export ATS document |
| `GET` | `/api/v1/extension/status` | Returns `{available, plan_required}` for current user's plan |
| `GET` | `/api/v1/extension/download` | Streams LinkedIn Job Copier ZIP to Pro/Elite users (403 for free) |
| `POST` | `/api/v1/payment/subscribe` | Create Razorpay checkout session (one-time 30-day pass or recurring monthly) |
| `POST` | `/api/v1/payment/verify` | Instantly verify checkout signature, activate Pro/Elite & grant credits |
| `POST` | `/api/v1/payment/webhook` | Razorpay recurring billing hooks (`subscription.charged`, `subscription.cancelled`) |
| `POST` | `/api/v1/admin/auth/verify-pin` | Layer 2 Admin PIN verification (issues 30m session token) |
| `GET` | `/api/v1/admin/stats/overview` | Platform overview: MRR, total users, analysis/tailoring stats |
| `GET` | `/api/v1/admin/users` | Paginated search, filter users by plan and role |
| `POST` | `/api/v1/admin/users/{id}/plan` | Update user plan & auto-assign tier credits (Pro: 200, Elite: 400) |
| `POST` | `/api/v1/admin/users/{id}/credits` | Top up or set exact user credit balance |
| `POST` | `/api/v1/admin/users/{id}/delete` | Permanently delete user and cascade purge resumes/analyses |
| `GET/POST` | `/api/v1/admin/config` | View and dynamically edit live `SiteConfig` values |
| `GET` | `/docs` | Swagger UI (development only) |
| `GET` | `/redoc` | ReDoc (development only) |

```bash
curl http://localhost:8000/api/v1/health

{
  "status": "ok",
  "environment": "development",

}

### Upload a DOCX resume

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/v1/documents/upload \
  -F "file=@/path/to/your/resume.docx"
```

```json
{
  "document_id": "f4bbba63-5194-47f9-8be6-729e6ed8737c",
  "filename": "resume.docx",
  "content_type": "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document",
  "size": 48291,
  "uploaded_at": "2026-07-09T12:47:29.638656Z",
  "status": "uploaded"
}
```

**Validation errors return 400:**

```bash
# Wrong extension
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/v1/documents/upload \
  -F "file=@resume.pdf"
# → 400: "Invalid file type. Only .docx files are accepted."

# File over 5 MB
# → 400: "File too large. Maximum allowed size is 5 MB."
```

## Development Notes

### Adding a new feature router

1. Create `backend/app/api/v1/<feature>.py` with an `APIRouter`.
2. Import it in `backend/app/api/router.py` and call `api_router.include_router(...)`.

### Raising application errors

```python
from app.core.exceptions import NotFoundError

raise NotFoundError("Resume 42 does not exist.")
```

All `AppError` subclasses are caught by the global exception handler and
returned as a consistent JSON body with the correct HTTP status code.

### Environment variables

Every supported variable is documented in `backend/.env.example`.
````

## File: backend/app/api/router.py
````python
"""Top-level API router.

All versioned sub-routers are mounted here.  ``factory.py`` includes this
single router on the FastAPI application, so adding a new feature only
requires importing its router and calling ``api_router.include_router``.

Convention
----------
- Each feature area gets its own file under ``api/v1/``.
- Routers from those files are included below with an explicit ``prefix``
  and ``tags`` list so the OpenAPI docs are organised by feature.
"""
from fastapi import APIRouter

from app.api.v1 import analysis, comparison, documents, health, job_descriptions, resume, review, auth, payment, history, structured_resume, tailor, support, extension, admin

api_router = APIRouter()

# health.py declares the /health path internally so no extra prefix is needed.
api_router.include_router(health.router)
api_router.include_router(auth.router)
api_router.include_router(payment.router)
api_router.include_router(documents.router)
api_router.include_router(job_descriptions.router)
api_router.include_router(analysis.router)
api_router.include_router(comparison.router)
````

## File: backend/app/core/database.py
````python
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, text
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.models import Base

import os

DB_FILE = os.getenv("DATABASE_FILE", "rolecraft.db")
DATABASE_URL = f"sqlite:///{DB_FILE}"

engine = create_engine(
    DATABASE_URL, connect_args={"check_same_thread": False}
)
SessionLocal = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine)

def init_db() -> None:
    """Ensure database tables are created and migrate lightweight schema additions."""
    Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
    # Ensure all new columns exist on users table for existing databases using isolated transactions
    columns_to_add = [
        ("daily_target", "INTEGER DEFAULT 10"),
        ("base_cover_letter_id", "VARCHAR(36)"),
        ("base_cover_letter_filename", "VARCHAR(255)"),
        ("phone_number", "VARCHAR(50)"),
        ("address", "VARCHAR(255)"),
        ("linkedin_url", "VARCHAR(255)"),
        ("missing_skills_tracker", "TEXT"),
        ("is_admin", "BOOLEAN DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL"),
        ("plan_expires_at", "DATETIME"),
    ]
    for col_name, col_type in columns_to_add:
        try:
            with engine.begin() as conn:
                conn.execute(text(f"ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN {col_name} {col_type}"))
        except Exception:
            pass  # Column already exists

    # Auto-migrate original_docx_path for structured_resumes table
    try:
        with engine.begin() as conn:
            conn.execute(text("ALTER TABLE structured_resumes ADD COLUMN original_docx_path VARCHAR"))
    except Exception:
        pass  # Column already exists

    # Ensure tailored_resumes table is created
    try:
        with engine.begin() as conn:
            conn.execute(text("""
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tailored_resumes (
                    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                    user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    job_id VARCHAR,
                    job_title VARCHAR,
                    job_company VARCHAR,
                    tailored_resume_json TEXT NOT NULL,
                    diff_json TEXT,
                    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                )
            """))
            conn.execute(text("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_tailored_resumes_user_id ON tailored_resumes (user_id)"))
    except Exception:
        pass

    # Ensure issue_reports table is created
    try:
        with engine.begin() as conn:
            conn.execute(text("""
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS issue_reports (
                    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                    user_id INTEGER,
                    user_email VARCHAR,
                    issue_type VARCHAR NOT NULL DEFAULT 'bug',
                    subject VARCHAR,
                    description TEXT NOT NULL,
                    context_data TEXT,
                    status VARCHAR NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open',
                    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                )
            """))
            conn.execute(text("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_issue_reports_user_id ON issue_reports (user_id)"))
            conn.execute(text("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_issue_reports_user_email ON issue_reports (user_email)"))
    except Exception:
        pass

    # Ensure admin_activity_logs table is created
    try:
        with engine.begin() as conn:
            conn.execute(text("""
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS admin_activity_logs (
                    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                    admin_email VARCHAR NOT NULL,
                    action VARCHAR NOT NULL,
                    target_user_id INTEGER,
                    payload_json TEXT,
                    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                )
            """))
            conn.execute(text("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_admin_activity_logs_admin_email ON admin_activity_logs (admin_email)"))
    except Exception:
        pass

    # Ensure site_config table is created
    try:
        with engine.begin() as conn:
            conn.execute(text("""
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS site_config (
                    key VARCHAR PRIMARY KEY,
                    value TEXT NOT NULL,
                    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                    updated_by VARCHAR
                )
            """))
    except Exception:
        pass


def get_db():
    """FastAPI route dependency to provide database session."""
    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()
````

## File: backend/app/dependencies/admin.py
````python
import secrets
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from typing import Dict, Any, Optional
from fastapi import Depends, Header, HTTPException, Query, status
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from loguru import logger

from app.core.database import get_db
from app.core.config import get_settings
from app.core.exceptions import UnauthorizedError, ForbiddenError
from app.dependencies.auth import get_current_user
from app.models import User

# In-memory admin session storage
# Token -> {"user_id": int, "email": str, "expires_at": datetime}
ADMIN_SESSIONS: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}

# Rate limiting for PIN attempts
# Key (email or IP) -> {"count": int, "locked_until": Optional[datetime]}
PIN_RATE_LIMITS: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}

MAX_PIN_ATTEMPTS = 5
LOCKOUT_MINUTES = 15
ADMIN_SESSION_TTL_MINUTES = 7 * 24 * 60  # 7 days (10,080 minutes)


def check_pin_rate_limit(client_id: str) -> None:
    """Check if the client is locked out due to excessive failed PIN attempts."""
    record = PIN_RATE_LIMITS.get(client_id)
    if not record:
        return

    locked_until = record.get("locked_until")
    if locked_until and datetime.utcnow() < locked_until:
        remaining_secs = int((locked_until - datetime.utcnow()).total_seconds())
        remaining_mins = max(1, remaining_secs // 60)
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_429_TOO_MANY_REQUESTS,
            detail=f"Too many failed PIN attempts. Locked out for {remaining_mins} more minutes.",
        )

    # If lockout expired, reset
    if locked_until and datetime.utcnow() >= locked_until:
        PIN_RATE_LIMITS.pop(client_id, None)


def record_pin_failure(client_id: str) -> None:
    """Record a failed PIN attempt and apply lockout if threshold exceeded."""
    record = PIN_RATE_LIMITS.setdefault(client_id, {"count": 0, "locked_until": None})
    record["count"] += 1
    if record["count"] >= MAX_PIN_ATTEMPTS:
        record["locked_until"] = datetime.utcnow() + timedelta(minutes=LOCKOUT_MINUTES)
        logger.warning(f"🚨 Admin PIN lockout triggered for {client_id} until {record['locked_until']}")


def reset_pin_attempts(client_id: str) -> None:
    """Reset failed attempts on successful verification."""
    PIN_RATE_LIMITS.pop(client_id, None)


def create_admin_session(user: User) -> str:
    """Issue a new random admin session token with 7 days TTL."""
    # Clean up any expired sessions
    now = datetime.utcnow()
    expired_keys = [k for k, v in ADMIN_SESSIONS.items() if v["expires_at"] < now]
    for k in expired_keys:
        ADMIN_SESSIONS.pop(k, None)

    token = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
    ADMIN_SESSIONS[token] = {
        "user_id": user.id,
        "email": user.email,
        "expires_at": now + timedelta(minutes=ADMIN_SESSION_TTL_MINUTES),
    }
    return token


def invalidate_admin_session(token: str) -> None:
    """Revoke an active admin session."""
    ADMIN_SESSIONS.pop(token, None)


def get_admin_user(
    x_admin_token: Optional[str] = Header(None, alias="X-Admin-Token"),
    admin_token_query: Optional[str] = Query(None, alias="admin_token"),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
) -> User:
    """Enforce two-layer authorization:
    
    1. User must be authenticated and have user.is_admin == True.
    2. Request must provide a valid, unexpired session token in X-Admin-Token header or ?admin_token query.
    """
    # Layer 1: Is the user an admin in DB?
    if not getattr(current_user, "is_admin", False):
        logger.warning(f"Forbidden admin access attempt by non-admin: {current_user.email}")
        raise ForbiddenError("Access denied. Admin privileges required.")

    # Layer 2: Is the session token valid and not expired?
    effective_token = x_admin_token or admin_token_query
    if not effective_token:
        raise UnauthorizedError("Admin session token is missing. Please enter your Admin Secret PIN.")

    session_info = ADMIN_SESSIONS.get(effective_token)
    if not session_info:
        raise UnauthorizedError("Admin session is invalid or expired. Please re-authenticate.")

    now = datetime.utcnow()
    if session_info["expires_at"] < now:
        ADMIN_SESSIONS.pop(effective_token, None)
        raise UnauthorizedError("Admin session has expired. Please enter your Admin Secret PIN.")

    if session_info["email"] != current_user.email:
        raise UnauthorizedError("Admin session token mismatch.")

    # Refresh expiry on active use (up to 30 min)
    session_info["expires_at"] = now + timedelta(minutes=ADMIN_SESSION_TTL_MINUTES)

    return current_user
````

## File: backend/app/dependencies/limits.py
````python
from fastapi import Depends
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from app.core.database import get_db
from app.core.exceptions import InsufficientCreditsError, UnauthorizedError
from app.dependencies.auth import get_optional_current_user, get_current_user
from app.models import User
from app.core.config import get_settings

_settings = get_settings()

def verify_analysis_permission(
    optional_user: User | None = Depends(get_optional_current_user)
) -> User:
    """Verify that the user has remaining credits or an active Pro/Elite subscription.

    This is the SINGLE credit gate in the system. Only the /resume/analyze endpoint
    uses this dependency. All other AI features are credit-free (but still auth-protected).
    """
    if not optional_user:
        raise UnauthorizedError(f"Authentication is required to analyze resumes. Sign up to get {_settings.FREE_TIER_CREDITS} free credits!")

    if optional_user.plan_type == "elite" and optional_user.subscription_status == "active":
        # Elite plan has unlimited usage
        return optional_user

    # Check credits for Free and Pro users
    if optional_user.credits <= 0:
        raise InsufficientCreditsError("You have depleted your available credits. Please upgrade your plan to continue.")

    return optional_user


def verify_user_credits(user: User, required_credits: int = 1) -> None:
    """Ensure candidate has enough credits for the requested AI operation.

    NOTE: Only called from the /analyze endpoint. No other endpoint charges credits.
    """
    if user.plan_type == "elite" and user.subscription_status == "active":
        return
    if user.credits < required_credits:
        raise InsufficientCreditsError(
            f"You need at least {required_credits} CR to perform this operation (Current balance: {user.credits} CR). Please upgrade your plan to continue."
        )


def deduct_user_credits(db: Session, user: User, amount: int = 1) -> int:
    """Deduct specified credits and save to database.

    NOTE: Only called from the /analyze endpoint. No other endpoint deducts credits.
    """
    if user.plan_type == "elite" and user.subscription_status == "active":
        return user.credits
    user.credits = max(0, user.credits - amount)
    db.add(user)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(user)
    return user.credits


def deduct_analysis_credit(db: Session, user: User) -> None:
    """Deduct 1 credit for a resume analysis. This is the only place credits are consumed."""
    deduct_user_credits(db, user, 1)


def verify_premium_permission(
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user)
) -> User:
    """Require authentication only. No credit check.

    Previously also checked credits, but all non-analyze features are now credit-free.
    Kept for backwards compat on endpoint signatures; now effectively an auth-only guard.
    """
    return user


def verify_auth_only(
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user)
) -> User:
    """Require authentication only. No credit check.

    Use this for AI features that are free (rewrite, cover letter, tailor, batch-rewrite).
    Backend token limits are still enforced by the AI service layer.
    """
    return user
````

## File: docs/architecture.md
````markdown
# Architecture

## Overview

The application follows a modular, production-ready architecture.

```
                    Client

                       │

                       ▼

                FastAPI REST API

                       │

     ┌─────────────────┼─────────────────┐

     ▼                 ▼                 ▼

Document Service   AI Service     Resume Service

     ▼                 ▼                 ▼

Document Parser   LLM Providers   Resume Patcher

        ▼                              ▼

 Constants Layer              OpenAI / Claude / Gemini

                       ▼

                PostgreSQL + Redis

                       ▼

                 File Storage
```

---

## Layers

### API Layer

Responsible for:

- HTTP endpoints
- Authentication
- Validation
- Returning responses

No business logic.

---

### Service Layer

Contains business logic.

Examples:

- Resume analysis
- Resume optimization
- ATS scoring
- Keyword extraction
- Resume patching

---

### AI Layer

Responsible only for communicating with LLMs.

Responsibilities:

- Prompt construction
- Structured outputs
- Model routing
- Retry logic

No database access.

---

### Parser Layer

Responsible for reading documents.

Supported formats:

- DOCX (full paragraph + table extraction, bold-run detection)
- PDF (read-only)

Responsibilities:

- Extract paragraphs and detect bold runs (`is_bold` field on `ParsedParagraph`)
- Preserve formatting metadata
- Build internal document model
- Parse job descriptions with multi-domain technology and soft skill extraction

---

### Constants Layer

`app/constants/resume_keywords.py` — single source of truth for all keyword constants.

Contains:

- `UNIVERSAL_ROLE_TITLES` (260 entries) — job titles across all industries used for experience sub-section routing
- `PRESERVE_VERBATIM_SECTIONS` — sections that must never be rewritten (Additional Information, Languages, Declarations, etc.)
- `SKILLS_SECTION_KEYWORDS` — section title variants routed to the skills rewriter
- `SUMMARY_SECTION_KEYWORDS` — section title variants routed to the summary rewriter
- `EXPERIENCE_SECTION_KEYWORDS` — experience container section title keywords

Imported by `section_detector`, `rewrite_service`, `patch_service`, and `resume_analysis_workflow`. Eliminates duplicated lists across services.

---

### Resume Layer

Responsible for modifying documents.

Responsibilities:

- Apply approved changes
- Preserve formatting
- Generate updated DOCX

---

### Storage Layer

Stores:

- Uploaded resumes
- Generated resumes
- AI responses
- Version history

---

## Design Principles

- Clean Architecture
- SOLID
- Dependency Injection where appropriate
- Async-first
- Type hints everywhere
- Small focused modules
- Testability

---

## Future Components

- Background workers
- Resume versioning
- Multiple templates
- Multi-model AI routing
- ATS scoring engine
- ~~Authentication~~ ✅ Done
- ~~Billing~~ ✅ Done (Razorpay Pro/Elite, credit system)
- ~~Chrome Extension distribution~~ ✅ Done (LinkedIn Job Copier, backend-gated ZIP download)
- Team workspaces

---

## Project Rules

1. Large language models never directly modify DOCX files.
   LLMs only generate structured text changes. Python is solely responsible for updating documents while preserving formatting.

2. Keyword constants are never duplicated across services.
   All role titles, section name variants, and routing keywords live in `app/constants/resume_keywords.py` and are imported where needed.

3. Preserve-verbatim sections are never AI-rewritten.
   Sections in `PRESERVE_VERBATIM_SECTIONS` (Languages, Additional Information, Declarations, References, Interests, Hobbies, Driving License) are passed through unchanged at every pipeline layer.

4. Section heading detection uses all available signals.
   `_is_heading()` checks four independent signals: Word Heading style, SECTION_NAME_MAP text match, ALL-CAPS heuristic, and Bold-Normal run detection. This ensures compatibility with all major real-world DOCX template formats.

5. **Analyze-Only Credit Billing**.
   Only `POST /resume/analyze` deducts 1 credit (`deduct_analysis_credit`). All other AI endpoints (rewrite, batch-rewrite, cover letter, tailor) are credit-free. They are protected by authentication and OpenAI model/timeout limits to prevent token abuse, but do not consume user credits. Free users start with 15 credits (`FREE_TIER_CREDITS = 15`). Elite plan users have unlimited analyzes.

6. **Extension Delivered via Backend (not Chrome Web Store)**.
   `GET /api/v1/extension/download` streams a ZIP of the `linkedin-job-copier/` folder. This bypasses Chrome Web Store review delays while keeping distribution secure — the download is JWT-authenticated and gated to `pro` / `elite` `plan_type` + `active` `subscription_status`. Free-tier users receive 403.

7. **Admin Dashboard Undiscoverability & Two-Layer Security**.
   The admin portal is hosted at `admin.rolecraft.tech` (internally mapped to `/xrc-control`) and completely isolated from the consumer frontend with `robots.txt` disallow and `X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow`. Authentication requires two distinct gates: (1) Standard Bearer JWT verification where `user.is_admin == True`, and (2) Secret Admin PIN verification against server-configured `ADMIN_SECRET` generating a short-lived in-memory session token (`X-Admin-Token`, 30m TTL) with 5-attempt rate-limiting lockout. All admin modifications are recorded in an immutable `AdminActivityLog` audit table.

8. **Dual Billing Engine & Instant Checkout Verification**.
   Users can select between a **One-Off 30-Day Pass** (Razorpay Standard Orders via `client.order.create`, zero recurring auto-debit, 100% UPI/card support) and a **Recurring Monthly Subscription** (Razorpay Subscriptions via `client.subscription.create`). Instant verification (`POST /api/v1/payment/verify`) verifies the cryptographic payment signature on checkout completion and immediately activates the plan with full tier credits (Pro: 200, Elite: 400). Automatic pass expiration is enforced gracefully via `plan_expires_at` in the user authentication dependency (`get_current_user`).

9. **In-Container Extension Bundling**.
   The LinkedIn Job Copier Chrome extension source is bundled directly inside `backend/app/extension_src/`. This guarantees that in-container ZIP streaming (`GET /api/v1/extension/download`) operates independently of host filesystem mounts, with multiple fallbacks for local development.

10. **Admin User Deletion Safety & Decoupled Cascade**.
    Permanent deletion of user accounts via `POST /api/v1/admin/users/{id}/delete` enforces self-deletion protection (admin cannot delete their own account). It performs a complete cascade cleanup of user analysis history, master resumes, and tailored resumes, while setting `user_id = NULL` on issue reports to preserve support audit trails.
````

````typescript
  ArrowLeft,

export default function SingleUserDetailPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ id: string }>;

  const userId = parseInt(resolvedParams.id, 10);
  const router = useRouter();

  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [actionLoading, setActionLoading] = useState(false);
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = useState<{ type: "success" | "error"; text: string } | null>(null);

  // Form states
  const [credits, setCredits] = useState(0);
  const [planType, setPlanType] = useState("free");
  const [subStatus, setSubStatus] = useState("inactive");

  const currentAdminEmail = getAdminEmail();

  const loadUser = async () => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const data = await fetchUserDetail(userId);
      setUser(data);
      setCredits(data.credits);
      setPlanType(data.plan_type);
      setSubStatus(data.subscription_status);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed to load user profile.");
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isNaN(userId)) {
      loadUser();
    }
  }, [userId]);

  const handleUpdateCredits = async (mode: "set" | "add") => {
    setActionLoading(true);
    setFeedback(null);
    try {
      const res = await updateUserCredits(userId, credits, mode);
      setUser((prev) => (prev ? { ...prev, credits: res.new_credits } : null));
      setFeedback({
        type: "success",
        text: `Credits successfully ${mode === "add" ? "added" : "set"}. New balance: ${res.new_credits}`,
      });
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      setFeedback({ type: "error", text: err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed to update credits." });
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleUpdatePlan = async () => {
    setActionLoading(true);
    setFeedback(null);
    try {
      const res = await updateUserPlan(userId, planType, subStatus);
      setUser((prev) =>
        prev
          ? {
              ...prev,
              plan_type: res.plan_type,
              subscription_status: res.subscription_status,
              credits: res.credits ?? prev.credits,
            }
          : null
      );
      if (res.credits !== undefined) {
        setCredits(res.credits);
      }
      setFeedback({
        type: "success",
        text: `Plan updated to ${res.plan_type.toUpperCase()} (${res.subscription_status}). Credit balance: ${res.credits ?? credits}`,
      });
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      setFeedback({ type: "error", text: err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed to update plan." });
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleToggleAdmin = async () => {
    if (!user) return;
    const targetState = !user.is_admin;
    const confirmed = window.confirm(
      targetState
        ? `Promote ${user.email} to Administrator?`
        : `Remove Administrator access from ${user.email}?`
    );
    if (!confirmed) return;

    setActionLoading(true);
    setFeedback(null);
    try {
      const res = await toggleUserAdmin(userId, targetState);
      setUser((prev) => (prev ? { ...prev, is_admin: res.is_admin } : null));
      setFeedback({ type: "success", text: `User is now ${res.is_admin ? "an Admin" : "a regular user"}.` });
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      setFeedback({ type: "error", text: err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed to toggle admin role." });
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteUser = async () => {
    if (!user) return;
    if (user.email === currentAdminEmail) {
      alert("You cannot delete your own admin account.");
      return;

      `⚠️ PERMANENT ACCOUNT DELETION\n\nAre you sure you want to permanently delete user:\n${user.email} (ID: #${user.id})?\n\nThis will purge all analysis histories, tailored resumes, and credit balances. This action CANNOT be undone.`
    );
    if (!confirmed) return;

    setActionLoading(true);
    setFeedback(null);
    try {
      await deleteUser(user.id);
      alert(`User ${user.email} was successfully deleted.`);
      router.push("/xrc-control/dashboard/users");
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      setFeedback({ type: "error", text: err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed to delete user." });
      setActionLoading(false);
    }
  };

  if (isLoading) {

        <Loader2 className="w-6 h-6 animate-spin text-indigo-600" />

      </div>
    );
  }

    return (

        >
          <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" /> Back to Users
        </Link>
        <div className="p-6 rounded-2xl bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 text-rose-800 text-sm">
          {error || "User not found."}

  return (

      {/* Back button */}
      <Link
        href="/xrc-control/dashboard/users"
        className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800 transition-colors"
      >
        <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" /> Back to Users Table
      </Link>

      {/* Profile Header Card */}
      <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl p-6 border border-slate-200/80 shadow-xs flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
          <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-2xl bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-600 flex items-center justify-center">
            <UserIcon className="w-7 h-7" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <h1 className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-900">{user.name || "Unnamed User"}</h1>
              {user.is_admin && (
                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 border border-indigo-200/70">
                  <ShieldCheck className="w-3 h-3 text-indigo-600" />
                  Admin
                </span>
              )}
            </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-4 text-xs font-mono">
          <div className="p-3 bg-slate-50 rounded-xl border border-slate-200/60 text-center">
            <div className="text-slate-400 text-[10px] uppercase font-sans">Analyses</div>
            <div className="font-bold text-slate-800 text-sm">{user.analysis_count}</div>
          </div>
          <div className="p-3 bg-slate-50 rounded-xl border border-slate-200/60 text-center">
            <div className="text-slate-400 text-[10px] uppercase font-sans">Tailored</div>
            <div className="font-bold text-slate-800 text-sm">{user.tailored_count}</div>
          </div>
        </div>

        >
          {user.email === currentAdminEmail ? "Cannot Delete Self" : "Permanently Delete User"}
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
````

````typescript
  const [users, setUsers] = useState<AdminUserItem[]>([]);
  const [total, setTotal] = useState(0);
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [totalPages, setTotalPages] = useState(1);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [planFilter, setPlanFilter] = useState("all");
  const [adminFilter, setAdminFilter] = useState("all");
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Drawer state
  const [selectedUser, setSelectedUser] = useState<AdminUserDetail | null>(null);
  const [isDrawerLoading, setIsDrawerLoading] = useState(false);
  const [drawerActionLoading, setDrawerActionLoading] = useState(false);
  const [drawerMessage, setDrawerMessage] = useState<{ type: "success" | "error"; text: string } | null>(null);

  // Drawer Form States
  const [creditAmount, setCreditAmount] = useState<number>(20);
  const [editPlan, setEditPlan] = useState<string>("free");
  const [editStatus, setEditStatus] = useState<string>("inactive");

  const currentAdminEmail = getAdminEmail();

  const loadUsers = useCallback(async () => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const data = await fetchUsers({
        page,
        limit: 15,
        search: search.trim() || undefined,
        plan_type: planFilter !== "all" ? planFilter : undefined,
        is_admin: adminFilter === "admin" ? true : adminFilter === "regular" ? false : undefined,
      });
      setUsers(data.items);
      setTotal(data.total);
      setTotalPages(data.total_pages);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed to load users.");
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  }, [page, search, planFilter, adminFilter]);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadUsers();
  }, [loadUsers]);

    setIsDrawerLoading(true);
    setDrawerMessage(null);
    setSelectedUser(null);

    try {
      const detail = await fetchUserDetail(user.id);
      setSelectedUser(detail);
      setEditPlan(detail.plan_type);
      setEditStatus(detail.subscription_status);
      setCreditAmount(detail.credits);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed to fetch user details.");

      setIsDrawerLoading(false);
    }
  };

    setDrawerMessage(null);

      setDrawerMessage({
        type: "success",
        text: `Credits successfully ${mode === "add" ? "added" : "set"}. New balance: ${res.new_credits}`,
      });
      loadUsers();
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      setDrawerMessage({
        type: "error",
        text: err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed to update credits.",
      });
    } finally {
      setDrawerActionLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleUpdatePlan = async () => {
    if (!selectedUser) return;
    setDrawerActionLoading(true);
    setDrawerMessage(null);

    try {
      const res = await updateUserPlan(selectedUser.id, editPlan, editStatus);
      setSelectedUser((prev) =>
        prev
          ? {
              ...prev,
              plan_type: res.plan_type,
              subscription_status: res.subscription_status,
              credits: res.credits ?? prev.credits,
            }
          : null
      );
      if (res.credits !== undefined) {
        setCreditAmount(res.credits);
      }
      setDrawerMessage({
        type: "success",
        text: `Plan updated to ${res.plan_type.toUpperCase()} (${res.subscription_status}). Credits balance: ${res.credits ?? selectedUser.credits}`,
      });
      loadUsers();
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      setDrawerMessage({
        type: "error",
        text: err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed to update plan.",
      });
    } finally {
      setDrawerActionLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleToggleAdmin = async () => {
    if (!selectedUser) return;
    const targetState = !selectedUser.is_admin;
    const confirmed = window.confirm(
      targetState
        ? `Are you sure you want to promote ${selectedUser.email} to Administrator? They will have full access to this control panel.`
        : `Are you sure you want to remove Administrator privileges from ${selectedUser.email}?`
    );

    if (!confirmed) return;

    setDrawerActionLoading(true);
    setDrawerMessage(null);

    try {
      const res = await toggleUserAdmin(selectedUser.id, targetState);
      setSelectedUser((prev) => (prev ? { ...prev, is_admin: res.is_admin } : null));
      setDrawerMessage({
        type: "success",
        text: `User is now ${res.is_admin ? "an Administrator" : "a regular user"}.`,
      });
      loadUsers();
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      setDrawerMessage({
        type: "error",
        text: err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed to update admin role.",
      });
    } finally {
      setDrawerActionLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteUser = async (targetUser?: AdminUserItem | AdminUserDetail) => {
    const target = targetUser || selectedUser;
    if (!target) return;

    if (target.email === currentAdminEmail) {
      alert("You cannot delete your own admin account.");
      return;
    }

    const confirmed = window.confirm(
      `⚠️ PERMANENT ACCOUNT DELETION\n\nAre you sure you want to permanently delete user:\n${target.email} (ID: #${target.id})?\n\nThis will purge all analysis records, tailored resumes, and credit balances. This action CANNOT be undone.`
    );

    if (!confirmed) return;

    setDrawerActionLoading(true);
    try {
      await deleteUser(target.id);
      if (selectedUser?.id === target.id) {
        setSelectedUser(null);
      }
      loadUsers();
      alert(`User ${target.email} was successfully deleted.`);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed to delete user.";
      if (selectedUser?.id === target.id) {
        setDrawerMessage({ type: "error", text: msg });
      } else {
        alert(msg);
      }
    } finally {
      setDrawerActionLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900 tracking-tight">User Management</h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
            Search, inspect user profiles, grant credits, change plans, and promote admins.
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="text-xs font-semibold px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 border border-indigo-200/60 self-start sm:self-auto">
          Total Users: {total.toLocaleString()}
        </div>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 text-rose-800 text-sm flex items-center gap-3">
          <AlertCircle className="w-5 h-5 flex-shrink-0 text-rose-600" />
          <span>{error}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Filters Bar */}
      <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl p-4 border border-slate-200/80 shadow-xs flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4">
        {/* Search */}
        <div className="relative flex-1 min-w-[240px]">
          <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3.5 top-3" />
          <input
            type="text"
            value={search}
            onChange={(e) => {
              setSearch(e.target.value);
              setPage(1);
            }}
            placeholder="Search by email or name..."
            className="w-full pl-10 pr-4 py-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 text-xs text-slate-900 placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:border-transparent transition-all"
          />
        </div>

        {/* Filters */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 flex-wrap">
          {/* Plan filter */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-slate-500">
            <Filter className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <select
              value={planFilter}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setPlanFilter(e.target.value);
                setPage(1);
              }}
              className="px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white text-xs text-slate-700 font-medium focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 cursor-pointer"
            >
              <option value="all">All Plans</option>
              <option value="free">Free</option>
              <option value="pro">Pro</option>
              <option value="elite">Elite</option>
            </select>
          </div>

          {/* Admin filter */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-slate-500">
            <select
              value={adminFilter}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setAdminFilter(e.target.value);
                setPage(1);
              }}
              className="px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white text-xs text-slate-700 font-medium focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 cursor-pointer"
            >
              <option value="all">All Roles</option>
              <option value="admin">Admins Only</option>
              <option value="regular">Regular Users</option>
            </select>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Users Table */}
      <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/80 shadow-xs overflow-hidden">
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse text-xs">
            <thead>
              <tr className="bg-slate-50/70 border-b border-slate-200 text-slate-500 font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider">
                <th className="py-3.5 px-4 w-12">#</th>
                <th className="py-3.5 px-4">User</th>
                <th className="py-3.5 px-4">Role</th>
                <th className="py-3.5 px-4">Plan</th>
                <th className="py-3.5 px-4">Credits</th>
                <th className="py-3.5 px-4">Usage</th>
                <th className="py-3.5 px-4">Joined</th>
                <th className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right">Actions</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
              {isLoading ? (
                <tr>
                  <td colSpan={8} className="py-12 text-center text-slate-400">
                    <Loader2 className="w-5 h-5 animate-spin mx-auto text-indigo-600 mb-2" />
                    <span>Loading users...</span>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ) : users.length === 0 ? (
                <tr>
                  <td colSpan={8} className="py-12 text-center text-slate-400">
                    No users matching criteria.
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ) : (
                users.map((u) => (
                  <tr key={u.id} className="hover:bg-slate-50/70 transition-colors">
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-slate-400 font-mono">{u.id}</td>
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4">
                      <div className="font-semibold text-slate-900">{u.name || "Unnamed"}</div>
                      <div className="text-slate-500 font-mono text-[11px] mt-0.5">{u.email}</div>
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4">
                      {u.is_admin ? (
                        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 border border-indigo-200/70">
                          <ShieldCheck className="w-3 h-3 text-indigo-600" />
                          Admin
                        </span>
                      ) : (
                        <span className="text-slate-500 text-[11px]">User</span>
                      )}
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4">
                      <span
                        className={`inline-flex items-center text-[11px] font-semibold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md capitalize ${
                          u.plan_type === "elite"
                            ? "bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border border-amber-200/60"
                            : u.plan_type === "pro"
                            ? "bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 border border-indigo-200/60"
                            : "bg-slate-100 text-slate-600"
                        }`}
                      >
                        {u.plan_type}
                      </span>
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4 font-semibold text-slate-900 font-mono">
                      {u.credits}
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-slate-500 text-[11px]">
                      <span>{u.analysis_count} analyses</span>
                      <span className="mx-1">·</span>
                      <span>{u.tailored_count} tailored</span>
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-slate-500">
                      {new Date(u.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right">
                      <div className="inline-flex items-center justify-end gap-1.5">
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => handleOpenDrawer(u)}
                          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-100/70 text-slate-700 font-semibold text-xs transition-all cursor-pointer"
                        >
                          <Edit3 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-500" />
                          <span>Manage</span>
                        </button>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => handleDeleteUser(u)}
                          disabled={u.email === currentAdminEmail}
                          title={u.email === currentAdminEmail ? "Cannot delete self" : "Delete user"}
                          className="p-1.5 rounded-lg border border-rose-200/80 bg-rose-50/50 hover:bg-rose-100 text-rose-600 transition-all disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed cursor-pointer"
                        >
                          <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))
              )}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>

        {/* Pagination Footer */}
        <div className="p-4 border-t border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-slate-500">
          <div>
            Showing Page <span className="font-semibold text-slate-800">{page}</span> of{" "}
            <span className="font-semibold text-slate-800">{totalPages}</span> ({total} users)
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <button
              onClick={() => setPage((p) => Math.max(1, p - 1))}
              disabled={page <= 1 || isLoading}
              className="p-1.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50 disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed cursor-pointer"
            >
              <ChevronLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => setPage((p) => Math.min(totalPages, p + 1))}
              disabled={page >= totalPages || isLoading}
              className="p-1.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50 disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed cursor-pointer"
            >
              <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Slide-over Drawer */}
      {(selectedUser || isDrawerLoading) && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 overflow-hidden flex justify-end">
          {/* Backdrop */}
          <div
            className="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-900/30 backdrop-blur-xs transition-opacity"
            onClick={() => !drawerActionLoading && setSelectedUser(null)}
          />

          {/* Drawer Panel */}
          <div className="relative w-full max-w-lg bg-white shadow-2xl border-l border-slate-200 flex flex-col h-full z-10 overflow-y-auto">
            {isDrawerLoading || !selectedUser ? (
              <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-slate-400 gap-3">
                <Loader2 className="w-6 h-6 animate-spin text-indigo-600" />
                <span className="text-xs">Loading user profile...</span>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <>
                {/* Drawer Header */}
                <div className="p-6 border-b border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-between sticky top-0 bg-white z-10">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-600 flex items-center justify-center">
                      <UserIcon className="w-5 h-5" />
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900">{selectedUser.name || "User Details"}</h2>
                      <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 font-mono">{selectedUser.email}</p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setSelectedUser(null)}
                    disabled={drawerActionLoading}
                    className="p-2 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <X className="w-5 h-5" />
                  </button>
                </div>

                {/* Drawer Body */}
                <div className="p-6 space-y-6 flex-1">
                  {/* Feedback Message */}
                  {drawerMessage && (
                    <div
                      className={`p-3.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-medium flex items-center gap-2.5 ${
                        drawerMessage.type === "success"
                          ? "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-200"
                          : "bg-rose-50 text-rose-800 border border-rose-200"
                      }`}
                    >
                      {drawerMessage.type === "success" ? (
                        <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 flex-shrink-0 text-emerald-600" />
                      ) : (
                        <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 flex-shrink-0 text-rose-600" />
                      )}
                      <span>{drawerMessage.text}</span>
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {/* Section 1: Manage Credits */}
                  <div className="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200/80 space-y-3">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <Coins className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-600" />
                        <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-700">
                          Credit Balance
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <span className="text-sm font-extrabold text-slate-900 font-mono">
                        {selectedUser.credits}
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pt-1">
                      <input
                        type="number"
                        min="0"
                        value={creditAmount}
                        onChange={(e) => setCreditAmount(parseInt(e.target.value) || 0)}
                        className="w-24 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 font-mono"
                      />
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => handleUpdateCredits("set")}
                        disabled={drawerActionLoading}
                        className="flex-1 py-2 px-3 rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white font-semibold text-xs transition-all disabled:opacity-60 cursor-pointer"
                      >
                        Set Exact
                      </button>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => handleUpdateCredits("add")}
                        disabled={drawerActionLoading}
                        className="flex-1 py-2 px-3 rounded-xl border border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50 hover:bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-700 font-semibold text-xs transition-all disabled:opacity-60 cursor-pointer"
                      >
                        + Add Credits
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Section 2: Manage Plan & Subscription */}
                  <div className="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200/80 space-y-3">
                    <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-700 block">
                      Subscription Tier & Status
                    </span>
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                      <div>
                        <label className="block text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-500 mb-1">Plan</label>
                        <select
                          value={editPlan}
                          onChange={(e) => setEditPlan(e.target.value)}
                          className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white text-xs font-semibold text-slate-800 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500"
                        >
                          <option value="free">Free</option>
                          <option value="pro">Pro (₹399)</option>
                          <option value="elite">Elite (₹599)</option>
                        </select>
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <label className="block text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-500 mb-1">Status</label>
                        <select
                          value={editStatus}
                          onChange={(e) => setEditStatus(e.target.value)}
                          className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white text-xs font-semibold text-slate-800 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500"
                        >
                          <option value="active">Active</option>
                          <option value="inactive">Inactive</option>
                        </select>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={handleUpdatePlan}
                      disabled={drawerActionLoading}
                      className="w-full py-2 px-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 font-semibold text-xs transition-all disabled:opacity-60 cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      Save Subscription
                    </button>
                  </div>

                  {/* Section 3: Admin Status */}
                  <div className="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200/80 space-y-3">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <div>
                        <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-700 block">
                          Administrator Privileges
                        </span>
                        <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
                          Grants complete access to this control panel.
                        </p>
                      </div>
                      {selectedUser.is_admin ? (
                        <ShieldCheck className="w-5 h-5 text-indigo-600" />
                      ) : (
                        <ShieldAlert className="w-5 h-5 text-slate-400" />
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={handleToggleAdmin}
                      disabled={
                        drawerActionLoading ||
                        (selectedUser.email === currentAdminEmail && selectedUser.is_admin)
                      }
                      className={`w-full py-2 px-3 rounded-xl font-semibold text-xs transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                        selectedUser.is_admin
                          ? "border border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 hover:bg-rose-100 text-rose-700"
                          : "border border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50 hover:bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-700"
                      } disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed`}
                    >
                      {selectedUser.email === currentAdminEmail && selectedUser.is_admin
                        ? "Cannot Demote Self (Protected)"
                        : selectedUser.is_admin
                        ? "Demote from Admin"
                        : "Promote to Admin"}
                    </button>
                  </div>

                  {/* Section: Danger Zone */}
                  <div className="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-rose-50/70 border border-rose-200/80 space-y-3">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <div>
                        <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-rose-800 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                          <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-rose-600" />
                          Danger Zone
                        </span>
                        <p className="text-[11px] text-rose-600/80 mt-0.5">
                          Permanently delete user account and all resume/analysis data.
                        </p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => handleDeleteUser()}
                      disabled={drawerActionLoading || selectedUser.email === currentAdminEmail}
                      className="w-full py-2 px-3 rounded-xl bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-700 text-white font-semibold text-xs transition-all shadow-xs disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      {selectedUser.email === currentAdminEmail ? "Cannot Delete Self" : "Permanently Delete User"}
                    </button>
                  </div>

                  {/* Section 4: Readonly Profile Data */}
                  <div className="border-t border-slate-100 pt-4 space-y-3 text-xs">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-slate-600">
                      <span className="text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                        <Calendar className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Registered:
                      </span>
                      <span>{new Date(selectedUser.created_at).toLocaleString()}</span>
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-slate-600">
                      <span className="text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                        <UserIcon className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Auth Provider:
                      </span>
                      <span className="capitalize">{selectedUser.provider}</span>
                    </div>

                    {selectedUser.phone_number && (
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-slate-600">
                        <span className="text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                          <Phone className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Phone:
                        </span>
                        <span>{selectedUser.phone_number}</span>
                      </div>
                    )}

                    {selectedUser.linkedin_url && (
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-slate-600">
                        <span className="text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                          <Globe className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> LinkedIn:
                        </span>
                        <a
                          href={selectedUser.linkedin_url}
                          target="_blank"
                          rel="noreferrer"
                          className="text-indigo-600 hover:underline truncate max-w-[200px]"
                        >
                          {selectedUser.linkedin_url}
                        </a>
                      </div>
                    )}

                    {selectedUser.base_resume_filename && (
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-slate-600">
                        <span className="text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                          <FileText className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Master Resume:
                        </span>
                        <span className="font-mono truncate max-w-[200px]">
                          {selectedUser.base_resume_filename}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
````

## File: frontend/src/components/auth_modal.tsx
````typescript
"use client";

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { useAuth } from "./auth_provider";
import { GoogleLogin } from "@react-oauth/google";
import { FREE_TIER_CREDITS } from "@/lib/constants";
import { X, Sparkles, Mail, Lock, AlertCircle, RefreshCw, User } from "lucide-react";

export default function AuthModal() {
  const { showAuthModal, setShowAuthModal, login, signup, googleLogin } = useAuth();
  const [authMode, setAuthMode] = useState<"signin" | "signup" | "forgot">("signin");
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [confirmPassword, setConfirmPassword] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [successMessage, setSuccessMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);

  if (!showAuthModal) return null;

  const handleForgotPassword = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setSuccessMessage(null);
    const emailClean = email.trim();
    if (!emailClean) {
      setError("Please enter your email address.");
      return;
    }
    setIsSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const rawApiUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || "http://localhost:8000";
      const apiUrl = rawApiUrl.replace(/\/api\/v1\/?$/, "");
      const res = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/v1/auth/forgot-password`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ email: emailClean }),
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok || data?.success === false) {
        setError(data?.message || data?.error?.detail || "Password reset request failed.");
        return;
      }
      setSuccessMessage(data.message || `Password reset instructions have been sent to ${emailClean}.`);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err?.message || "Password reset request failed.");
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (authMode === "forgot") {
      return handleForgotPassword(e);
    }

    setError(null);
    setSuccessMessage(null);

    const emailClean = email.trim();
    if (!emailClean || !password) {
      setError("Please fill in all fields.");
      return;
    }

    if (authMode === "signup" && password !== confirmPassword) {
      setError("Passwords do not match.");
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);
    try {
      if (authMode === "signup") {
        await signup(emailClean, password, name.trim() || undefined);
      } else {
        await login(emailClean, password);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err?.message || "An authentication error occurred.");
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleGoogleSuccess = async (credentialResponse: any) => {
    setError(null);
    setSuccessMessage(null);
    setIsSubmitting(true);
    try {
      if (credentialResponse.credential) {
        await googleLogin(credentialResponse.credential);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err?.message || "Google Sign-in failed.");
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[1000] flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-4 bg-slate-900/40 backdrop-blur-md animate-fade-in-up">
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-md rounded-2xl p-5 sm:p-8 border border-teal-100 bg-white shadow-2xl flex flex-col space-y-5 sm:space-y-6 max-h-[92vh] overflow-y-auto">
        {/* Close Button */}
        <button
          onClick={() => setShowAuthModal(false)}
          className="absolute top-4 right-4 p-1.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-100 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
        >
          <X className="h-4 w-4" />
        </button>

        {/* Brand Header */}
        <div className="text-center space-y-2">
          <div className="h-12 w-12 rounded-xl icon-gradient bg-gradient-to-br from-teal-600 to-teal-500 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto shadow-md">
            <Sparkles className="h-6 w-6 text-white animate-pulse" />
          </div>
          <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-900">
            {authMode === "signup"
              ? "Create your account"
              : authMode === "forgot"
              ? "Reset your password"
              : "Sign in to RoleCraft"}
          </h2>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
            {authMode === "forgot"
              ? "Enter your email address to receive password reset instructions."
              : `Get ${FREE_TIER_CREDITS} free optimization credits and unlock AI rewrites.`}
          </p>
        </div>

            <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />

  );
````

## File: frontend/src/components/resume_download_panel.tsx
````typescript
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import {
  Download, FileText, Sparkles, Loader2, AlertTriangle, Palette,
  CheckCircle2, ChevronRight
} from "lucide-react";
import {
  downloadStructuredResume,
  exportOriginalResume,
  downloadTailoredResume,
} from "@/lib/structured_resume_api";

interface ResumeDownloadPanelProps {
  /** "docx" if user uploaded a DOCX (original design available), "pdf" or null otherwise */
  sourceFormat?: "docx" | "pdf" | "manual" | null;
  /** If set, downloads use tailored content instead of master */
  tailoredResumeId?: number;
  /** Display name for the tailored job */
  tailoredJobLabel?: string;
  /** Optional full name for download filename */
  fullName?: string;
  /** Compact layout for embedding inside another modal */
  compact?: boolean;
}

const TEMPLATES = [
  {
    id: "original",
    label: "Original Design",
    desc: "Your uploaded DOCX layout",
    icon: Palette,
    bgLight: "bg-purple-50/80 hover:bg-purple-100/80 border-purple-200 text-purple-950",
    iconColor: "text-purple-600",
    requiresDocx: true,
  },
  {
    id: "clean_classic",
    label: "Clean Classic",
    desc: "Minimal ATS-optimised",
    icon: FileText,
    bgLight: "bg-teal-50/80 hover:bg-[#E6F7F4]/80 border-teal-200 text-[#0F172A]",
    iconColor: "text-teal-600",
    requiresDocx: false,
  },
  {
    id: "modern_professional",
    label: "Modern Professional",
    desc: "Bold & contemporary",
    icon: Sparkles,
    bgLight: "bg-cyan-50/80 hover:bg-cyan-100/80 border-cyan-200 text-cyan-950",
    iconColor: "text-cyan-600",
    requiresDocx: false,
  },
  {
    id: "executive_profile",
    label: "Executive Profile",
    desc: "Premium with photo",
    icon: CheckCircle2,
    bgLight: "bg-amber-50/80 hover:bg-amber-100/80 border-amber-200 text-amber-950",
    iconColor: "text-amber-600",
    requiresDocx: false,
  },
] as const;

export default function ResumeDownloadPanel({
  sourceFormat,
  tailoredResumeId,
  tailoredJobLabel,
  fullName,
  compact = false,
}: ResumeDownloadPanelProps) {
  const [format, setFormat] = useState<"pdf" | "docx">("pdf");
  const [downloading, setDownloading] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [successTemplate, setSuccessTemplate] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const hasOriginalDesign = sourceFormat === "docx";

  const handleDownload = async (templateId: string) => {
    setError(null);
    setDownloading(templateId);
    setSuccessTemplate(null);

    const namePrefix = fullName ? `${fullName} - ` : "";
    const jobLabel = tailoredJobLabel ? ` (${tailoredJobLabel})` : "";

    try {
      if (templateId === "original") {
        const filename = `${namePrefix}Resume${jobLabel} - Original Design.docx`;
        await exportOriginalResume(tailoredResumeId, filename);
      } else {
        const filename = `${namePrefix}Resume${jobLabel} - ${templateId.replace(/_/g, " ").replace(/\b\w/g, (c) => c.toUpperCase())}.${format}`;
        if (tailoredResumeId != null) {
          await downloadTailoredResume(tailoredResumeId, templateId, format, filename);
        } else {
          await downloadStructuredResume(templateId, format, filename);
        }
      }
      setSuccessTemplate(templateId);
      setTimeout(() => setSuccessTemplate(null), 1000);
    } catch (err: any) {
      if (templateId === "original" && err.message?.includes("injection")) {
        // Graceful fallback to Clean Classic
        setError("Original design injection failed for this complex layout — downloading Clean Classic instead.");
        try {
          const fallbackFilename = `${namePrefix}Resume${jobLabel} - Clean Classic.${format}`;
          if (tailoredResumeId != null) {
            await downloadTailoredResume(tailoredResumeId, "clean_classic", format, fallbackFilename);
          } else {
            await downloadStructuredResume("clean_classic", format, fallbackFilename);
          }
        } catch {
          // ignore fallback error
        }
      } else {
        setError(err.message || "Download failed. Please try again.");
      }
    } finally {
      setDownloading(null);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className={compact ? "space-y-3" : "space-y-4"}>
      {/* Format Toggle Bar */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700">File Format:</span>
        <div className="flex bg-slate-100 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-1 gap-1">
          {(["pdf", "docx"] as const).map((f) => (
            <button
              key={f}
              onClick={() => setFormat(f)}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                format === f
                  ? "bg-white text-teal-600 shadow-sm border border-slate-200"
                  : "text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900"
              }`}
            >
              {f.toUpperCase()}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Template Grid */}
      <div className={`grid ${compact ? "grid-cols-2 gap-2.5" : "grid-cols-2 gap-3"}`}>
        {TEMPLATES.map((tmpl) => {
          const disabled = tmpl.requiresDocx && !hasOriginalDesign;
          const isDownloading = downloading === tmpl.id;
          const isSuccess = successTemplate === tmpl.id;
          const Icon = tmpl.icon;

          return (
            <button
              key={tmpl.id}
              onClick={() => !disabled && handleDownload(tmpl.id)}
              disabled={disabled || !!downloading}
              className={`relative flex items-center gap-3 p-3 rounded-2xl border transition-all text-left shadow-sm
                ${disabled
                  ? "opacity-40 cursor-not-allowed border-slate-200 bg-slate-50"
                  : `${tmpl.bgLight} cursor-pointer hover:shadow-md active:scale-[0.98]`
                }
                ${!!downloading && !isDownloading ? "opacity-50" : ""}
              `}
            >
              <div className={`w-9 h-9 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center shrink-0
                ${disabled ? "bg-slate-200" : "bg-white/80 shadow-xs"}`}>
                {isDownloading ? (
                  <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 text-teal-600 animate-spin" />
                ) : isSuccess ? (
                  <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" />
                ) : (
                  <Icon className={`w-4 h-4 ${disabled ? "text-slate-400" : tmpl.iconColor}`} />
                )}
              </div>
              <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <div className={`text-xs font-bold truncate ${disabled ? "text-slate-400" : "text-slate-900"}`}>
                  {tmpl.label}
                </div>
                <div className={`text-[11px] font-medium truncate ${disabled ? "text-slate-400" : "text-slate-500"}`}>
                  {disabled ? "DOCX upload required" : tmpl.requiresDocx ? "Your DOCX layout" : tmpl.desc}
                </div>
              </div>
              {!disabled && !isDownloading && !isSuccess && (
                <Download className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 shrink-0" />
              )}
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* Error Alert */}
      {error && (
        <div className="flex items-start gap-2 px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 text-amber-800 text-xs font-medium">
          <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-amber-600" />
          <span>{error}</span>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
````

````python
import json
import math
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from typing import Optional, List, Any, Dict
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Query, HTTPException, status

from sqlalchemy import func, or_, desc, asc
from loguru import logger

from app.core.database import get_db
from app.core.config import get_settings
from app.core.exceptions import UnauthorizedError, NotFoundError, BadRequestError, ForbiddenError
from app.dependencies.auth import get_current_user
from app.dependencies.admin import (
    get_admin_user,
    check_pin_rate_limit,
    record_pin_failure,
    reset_pin_attempts,
    create_admin_session,
    ADMIN_SESSION_TTL_MINUTES,
)
from app.models import (
    User,
````
